strings.Odejście z pracy z dnia na dzień — kiedy: Leaving a job overnight — when can an employee receive compensation?
strings.Data publikacji: 25 lipca 2026 · Autor:: Published: 25 July 2026 · Author: Dariusz Włodarczyk Kancelaria TRC · Reading time: approx. 5 min
strings.Zdarza się, że pracodawca przestaje wypł: It happens that an employer stops paying wages, grossly breaches health and safety rules or otherwise seriously violates an employee's rights. In such situations the Labour Code allows you to leave the job immediately — without notice — and to claim compensation. Below we explain when and on what terms this is possible.
strings.<a href=\"#kiedy\">Kiedy pracownik może: When an employee may leave without notice
strings.<a href=\"#odszkodowanie\">Jakie odszkod: What compensation the employee is entitled to
strings.<a href=\"#pismo\">O czym pamiętać przed: What to remember before submitting the letter
strings.<a href=\"#ryzyko\">Uwaga: pracodawca ta: Note: the employer can also defend itself
strings.1. Kiedy pracownik może odejść bez wypow: 1. When an employee may leave without notice
strings.Pracownik może rozwiązać umowę o pracę b: An employee may terminate the employment contract without notice if the employer has committed a serious breach of its basic obligations towards the employee (Article 55 § 11 of the Labour Code). In practice this mainly means persistent non-payment of wages, significant delays in payment, serious breaches of health and safety rules or other particularly gross violations of employee rights.
strings.<strong>Dotyczy także cudzoziemców.</str: This also applies to foreigners. The right to terminate a contract under Article 55 of the Labour Code belongs to every employee working under an employment contract, regardless of citizenship. A separate issue is the effect of the end of employment on the validity of a work or residence permit — this should be planned before leaving.
strings.2. Jakie odszkodowanie przysługuje praco: 2. What compensation the employee is entitled to
strings.Jeżeli rozwiązanie umowy w trybie art. 5: If terminating the contract under Article 55 of the Labour Code was justified, the employee may claim compensation equal to the remuneration for the notice period. For contracts concluded for an indefinite and for a fixed term, the compensation corresponds to the remuneration for the notice period, and if the contract was concluded for a shorter fixed term — for the period until the contract was to last, but no more than for the notice period. This means that leaving overnight does not have to mean losing the money that would correspond to an ordinary notice period.
strings.3. O czym pamiętać przed złożeniem pisma: 3. What to remember before submitting the letter
strings.Oświadczenie o rozwiązaniu umowy powinno: The declaration terminating the contract should be submitted in writing, stating the reason justifying the termination. It is worth keeping a copy of the document and gathering evidence of the employer's breaches.
strings.korespondencja z pracodawcą (e-maile, wi: correspondence with the employer (e-mails, messages, payment demands),
strings.potwierdzenia przelewów i paski wynagrod: confirmations of transfers and payslips showing missing or delayed payments,
strings.notatki dotyczące warunków pracy, zgłosz: notes on working conditions, health and safety reports, documentation of the state of the workstation.
strings.<strong>Termin.</strong> Rozwiązanie umo: Deadline. Termination of the contract without notice through the fault of the employer may not take place more than 1 month after the employee learns of the circumstance justifying the termination (Article 55 § 2 in conjunction with Article 52 § 2 of the Labour Code). Do not delay your decision for too long.
strings.4. Uwaga: pracodawca także może się bron: 4. Note: the employer can also defend itself
strings.Jeżeli pracownik <strong>bezzasadnie</st: If an employee invokes Article 55 of the Labour Code without justification, the employer may claim compensation of its own. That is why, before taking a decision, it is worth checking carefully whether the breaches really are serious and whether they can be proved. Whether a breach is "serious" can be a matter of dispute — in case of doubt it is safer to consult a lawyer before submitting the declaration.
strings.Nie masz pewności, czy Twoja sytuacja uz: Not sure whether your situation justifies leaving?
strings.Sprawdzimy Twoją umowę, ocenimy ryzyko i: We will check your contract, assess the risk and help you prepare the declaration terminating the contract — so as to protect your rights and, if you are a foreigner, your residence status.
strings.<strong>Nota prawna:</strong> artykuł ma: Legal note: this article is informative and does not constitute legal advice. Legal status: July 2026 (Act of 26 June 1974 — the Labour Code, Article 55). Every case is different — consult a lawyer before taking a decision. Data controller: Dariusz Włodarczyk Kancelaria TRC.

The above discussion is our own; the provisions cited should be verified against the current text of the act before taking action.

strings.Nie dostałeś wezwania z urzędu? Tak może: Did you not receive a summons from the office? This is how you can lose your residence card
strings.Data publikacji: 18 sierpnia 2026 · Auto: Date of publication: 18 August 2026 · Author: Dariusz Włodarczyk Kancelaria TRC · Reading time: approx. 5 min
strings.W sprawach o kartę pobytu jedno nieodebr: In residence card cases, a single uncollected summons from the office can change everything. The worst part is that the foreigner is often the last to learn about the problem — when the case is already closed. If your correspondence is collected by your employer or an agency, this article may save you from losing your legal stay. See how service of documents works and what to do when the deadline has already passed.
strings.<a href=\"#sek1\">Dlaczego wezwanie z ur: Why the summons from the office may not have reached you
strings.<a href=\"#sek2\">Co grozi, gdy minie te: What happens when the deadline to supplement deficiencies expires?
strings.<a href=\"#sek3\">Co robić, jeśli termin: What to do if the deadline has already passed?
strings.<a href=\"#sek4\">Jak nie dopuścić do ta: How to prevent such a situation?
strings.1. Dlaczego wezwanie z urzędu mogło do C: 1. Why the summons from the office may not have reached you
strings.Jeśli w sprawie działa pełnomocnik, urzą: If a representative acts in the case, the office serves documents on them — not on you (Art. 40 § 2 of the Code of Administrative Procedure, KPA). When the representative is your employer or an agency, the summons to supplement the formal deficiencies of the application goes to the company, and the time limit runs regardless of whether anyone passed it on to you.
strings.<strong>To nie jest wina urzędu.</strong: This is not the office's fault. From the procedural point of view, service on the representative is effective. That is why it matters so much WHO your representative is and whether they really look after your case.
strings.2. Co grozi, gdy minie termin na uzupełn: 2. What happens when the deadline to supplement formal deficiencies expires?
strings.Organ może pozostawić wniosek bez rozpoz: The authority may leave the application without examination (Art. 64 § 2 KPA). The case is then not decided on the merits — as if the application had never been filed. In residence cases this may mean the loss of the basis for legal stay and the need to rebuild your situation from scratch.
strings.3. Co robić, jeśli termin już minął?: 3. What to do if the deadline has already passed?
strings.ustal natychmiast stan sprawy: numer, or: establish the status of the case immediately: the file number, the authority handling it, what was sent and when,
strings.zdobądź kopie wezwań i potwierdzeń doręc: obtain copies of the summonses and proofs of service (you have the right to inspect the file — Art. 73 KPA),
strings.sprawdź, czy doręczenie było prawidłowe: check whether service was correct — errors in service do happen,
strings.zbierz dowody, że pełnomocnik nie przeka: gather evidence that the representative did not pass the information on to you,
strings.nie wysyłaj pism „z wzoru\" bez analizy: do not send letters „from a template” without analysis — an ill-considered letter may close doors that are still open.
strings.O tym, jakie środki przysługują (ponagle: We write in detail about the available remedies (ponaglenie — a formal reminder urging the authority to act, and a complaint about inaction) and how to use them in the next part of the series: an application left without examination — how to save the case.
strings.4. Jak nie dopuścić do takiej sytuacji?: 4. How to prevent such a situation?
strings.Zadbaj, by korespondencja w Twojej spraw: Make sure the correspondence in your case reaches you or a representative who acts solely in your interest and reports every move of the office to you. If your case is currently handled by a company, read our comparison: lawyer or employer and what to do when the employer will not return your documents.
strings.Czy urząd musi zawiadamiać mnie osobiści: Must the office notify me personally if I have a representative?
strings.Nie. Jeżeli ustanowiono pełnomocnika, pi: No. If a representative has been appointed, documents are served on the representative (Art. 40 § 2 KPA) and such service is effective towards you.
strings.Skąd mam wiedzieć, że urząd coś wysłał?: How am I to know that the office has sent something?
strings.Możesz przeglądać akta swojej sprawy (ar: You may inspect the file of your case (Art. 73 KPA), and in cases filed via MOS — track the case in the system. You may also withdraw the power of attorney at any time so that correspondence goes to you.
strings.Czy pozostawienie wniosku bez rozpoznani: Is leaving an application without examination a refusal decision?
strings.Nie — to zakończenie sprawy bez oceny me: No — it is the closing of the case without an assessment on the merits. The way of responding differs from an appeal against a decision; see the next article in the series on saving such a case.
strings.Podejrzewasz, że ominęło Cię wezwanie?: Do you suspect that a summons passed you by?
strings.Bezpłatnie przeanalizujemy dokumenty, kt: We will analyse the documents you hold free of charge and help establish the status of your case — before further deadlines expire. Act while there is still something to save.

strings.Data publikacji: 26 lipca 2026 · Autor:: Published: 26 July 2026 · Author: Dariusz Włodarczyk Kancelaria TRC · Reading time: approx. 6 min
strings.Zezwolenie może zostać cofnięte, uchylon: A permit may be withdrawn, revoked or simply expire. We explain the differences between these situations, their consequences for the legality of work and residence, and how to react.
strings.Organ pozbawia zezwolenia z przyczyn wsk: The authority deprives the holder of the permit on grounds set out in the act
strings.Wyeliminowanie zezwolenia z obrotu prawn: Removal of the permit from legal circulation in specified cases

strings.2. Skutki dla pracownika i pracodawcy: 2. Consequences for the employee and the employer
strings.Każda z tych sytuacji oznacza <strong>ut: Each of these situations means losing the basis for work, and in the case of a single permit it may affect residence as well. A quick reaction is necessary so that the work does not become illegal.
strings.<strong>Uwaga:</strong> po ustaniu zatru: Note: after the end of employment or the withdrawal of the document, continued work is illegal — see penalties.
strings.Ustal przyczynę i podstawę prawną rozstr: Establish the reason and the legal basis of the decision, check whether an appeal is possible and sort out the employee's residence situation (e.g. a new basis for work or residence).
strings.Najlepszą profilaktyką jest pilnowanie w: The best prevention is keeping to the conditions stated in the document, meeting deadlines and fulfilling obligations towards the authority — see the checklist.

strings.Od decyzji o cofnięciu lub uchyleniu zwy: A decision on withdrawal or revocation may usually be appealed within the statutory time limit. It is worth assessing the chances and the arguments before lodging an appeal — sometimes it is more advantageous to regularise the situation on a new basis at the same time.

strings.Czy cudzoziemiec podlega ubezpieczeniom: Is a foreigner subject to ZUS social insurance in Poland
strings.Data publikacji: 31 lipca 2026 · Autor:: Published: 31 July 2026 · Author: Dariusz Włodarczyk Kancelaria TRC · Reading time: approx. 6 min
strings.Zatrudniasz cudzoziemca i nie wiesz, czy: You employ a foreigner and are not sure whether to pay contributions for them? We explain the territoriality principle, how to register with ZUS and the situations in which contributions remain abroad.
strings.<a href=\"#wyjatki\">Kiedy składek w Pol: When no contributions are due in Poland
strings.Polski system ubezpieczeń społecznych op: The Polish social insurance system is based on the territoriality principle: as a rule, insurance covers a person performing work on Polish territory, regardless of citizenship. An employee hired under an employment contract is subject to compulsory insurance (Article 6(1)(1) of the Social Insurance System Act).
strings.<strong>W skrócie:</strong> jeśli cudzoz: In short: if a foreigner works legally in Poland under an employment contract, the employer registers them with ZUS and pays contributions exactly as for a Polish citizen.
strings.Pracownika zgłasza się do ubezpieczeń na: An employee is registered for insurance using form ZUS ZUA (full insurance) or ZUS ZZA (health insurance only, where social contributions are not due). Registration must be made within the statutory deadline from the moment the obligation arises.

strings.Jak odzyskać dokumenty do karty pobytu o: How to recover residence card documents from an employer or agency?
strings.Data publikacji: 11 sierpnia 2026 · Auto: Published: 11 August 2026 · Author: Dariusz Włodarczyk Kancelaria TRC · Reading time: approx. 5 min
strings.Wielu cudzoziemców orientuje się zbyt pó: Many foreigners realise far too late that they have no access to the most important documents in their own residence card case. Usually this happens when they have to answer a summons quickly or change jobs — and it suddenly turns out that everything is "with the company". In this article we show how to recover residence card documents effectively and without going to war with your employer.

strings.<a href=\"#sek2\">Jak odzyskać dokumenty: How to recover the documents step by step?

strings.1. Jakie dokumenty do karty pobytu są na: 1. Which residence card documents matter most?
strings.W praktyce liczą się przede wszystkim: u: In practice what counts most is: the employment or civil-law contract, the employer's annex to the application for temporary residence and work, confirmation of filing the application (UPO), summonses and letters from the authority, and confirmations of registration with ZUS. They determine whether you can prove your professional situation and reply to the authority on time.
strings.<strong>Uwaga na zezwolenia „przypisane\: Beware of permits "tied" to a company. If your temporary residence and work permit names a specific employer and working conditions, changing jobs requires action towards the voivode — you cannot simply start working somewhere else.
strings.2. Jak odzyskać dokumenty krok po kroku?: 2. How to recover the documents step by step?
strings.wyślij krótkie, konkretne wezwanie do wy: send a short, specific request for the release of the documents — with a list and a deadline,
strings.poproś o kopie w formie elektronicznej i: ask for copies in both electronic and paper form,
strings.nie ograniczaj się do rozmów telefoniczn: do not limit yourself to phone calls — a phone call leaves no trace,
strings.zachowaj dowody, że prosiłeś: e-maile, w: keep proof that you asked: e-mails, messages, postal confirmations,
strings.jeśli sprawa się przeciąga — przekaż ją: if the matter drags on — hand it over to a legal representative; a formal letter works fastest.
strings.3. Co grozi, gdy będziesz czekać?: 3. What are the risks of waiting?
strings.Każdy tydzień zwłoki zawęża pole manewru: Every week of delay narrows your room for manoeuvre. Without the documents it is harder to answer a summons from the authority, apply for a change of permit or show continuity of employment. In the worst case the matter ends with the application being left without examination — we wrote about this in the article what to do when the employer does not return your documents.
strings.4. Kiedy warto oddać sprawę pełnomocniko: 4. When is it worth handing the case to a legal representative?
strings.Jeśli pracodawca zwleka mimo pisemnych p: If the employer delays despite written requests, or if a deadline set by the authority is approaching — do not play for time. An independent representative will formally request the documents and make sure that correspondence from the authority reaches you, not the company. Before you decide whom to entrust with your case, see the comparison: lawyer or employer and the rules on changing employer with a residence card.
strings.Czy mogę żądać dokumentów po zakończeniu: Can I demand the documents after my employment has ended?
strings.Tak. Zakończenie zatrudnienia nie odbier: Yes. The end of employment does not deprive you of the right to documents concerning you and your residence case — the employer is required by law to issue a work certificate.
strings.W jakiej formie prosić o dokumenty?: In what form should I ask for the documents?
strings.Zawsze pisemnie (e-mail wystarczy), z li: Always in writing (an e-mail is enough), with a list of documents and a reasonable deadline. A written form creates evidence and usually spurs the other side into action.
strings.Czy urząd wyda mi kopie z akt sprawy?: Will the authority give me copies from the case file?
strings.Jako strona postępowania masz prawo wglą: As a party to the proceedings you have the right to inspect your case file and obtain copies from it (Article 73 of the Code of Administrative Procedure). This is often the fastest way to reconstruct documents that the company will not return.
strings.Przeanalizujemy bezpłatnie to, co masz,: We will analyse free of charge what you already have, tell you what is missing and formally request the rest — from the employer or from the case file at the authority.
strings.<strong>Nota prawna:</strong> artykuł ma: Legal note: this article is informative and does not constitute legal advice. The situations described are general and do not refer to any specific employer or agency. Legal status: August 2026 (Article 73 of the Code of Administrative Procedure; Article 97 of the Labour Code; Act on Foreigners). Every case is different — consult a lawyer before taking a decision. strings.Zezwolenie na pobyt czasowy to decyzja w: A temporary residence permit is a decision of the voivode allowing a foreigner to live legally in Poland for longer than 3 months — up to a maximum of 3 years (with no possibility of an "extension" — once it expires, a new application is filed). The physical confirmation of the permit is the residence card, which together with a passport also entitles you to travel within the Schengen area for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.

strings.Umowa zlecenie kuriera a stosunek pracy: Courier's mandate contract vs. employment relationship — lessons from the Labour Inspectorate and ZUS inspection at Pyszne.pl
strings.Data publikacji: 29 lipca 2026 · Autor:: Published: 29 July 2026 · Author: Dariusz Włodarczyk Kancelaria TRC · Reading time: approx. 7 min
strings.Głośna sprawa zapowiedzianych zwolnień o: The high-profile case of the announced dismissal of about 5,000 Pyszne.pl couriers and the inspections launched by the National Labour Inspectorate and ZUS clearly illustrates one of the most common traps of the delivery market: a contract labelled a "mandate" is not always a civil-law contract in the eyes of the law. If the work actually has the features of employment, it may be recognised as an employment relationship — with all the consequences that entails for the company and for the courier. In the delivery sector a very large share of couriers are foreigners, which is why this topic directly affects the legality of their work and stay. Below we explain the legal basis, possible scenarios and risks.
strings.<a href=\"#sek1\">Co się wydarzyło — kon: What happened — the Labour Inspectorate and ZUS inspection at Pyszne.pl
strings.<a href=\"#sek2\">Kiedy „zlecenie\" jest: When a "mandate" is in fact an employment relationship (Art. 22 of the Labour Code)
strings.<a href=\"#sek3\">Skutki przekwalifikowa: Consequences of reclassification: collective redundancies, contributions, courses of action
strings.<a href=\"#sek4\">Co to oznacza dla cudz: What it means for foreign couriers — risk assessment
strings.1. Co się wydarzyło — kontrola PIP i ZUS: 1. What happened — the Labour Inspectorate and ZUS inspection at Pyszne.pl
strings.Spółka działająca pod marką Pyszne.pl za: The company operating under the Pyszne.pl brand announced to couriers the termination of their existing contracts (concluded as civil-law contracts) and offered re-employment with selected "fleet partners", reportedly on less favourable terms (including without a guaranteed hourly rate). In response, the Ministry of Family, Labour and Social Policy applied to the Chief Labour Inspector for an urgent inspection of the basis of the couriers' employment, and ZUS also launched inspection activities — regarding the correctness of the insurance title. The Labour Inspectorate leadership announced that, where justified, it would seek to convert civil-law contracts into employment contracts, and that termination of a contract during an inspection would not block the finding of an employment relationship.
strings.<strong>Dla czytelnika-kuriera:</strong>: For the courier reader: the mere announcement of terminating a mandate contract during an inspection does not "cancel" your rights. If the work had the features of an employment relationship, its existence can be pursued even after the cooperation has ended.
strings.2. Kiedy „zlecenie\" jest w rzeczywistoś: 2. When a "mandate" is in fact an employment relationship (Art. 22 of the Labour Code)
strings.Kluczowy jest art. 22 Kodeksu pracy. Zgo: The key provision is Art. 22 of the Labour Code. Under Art. 22 § 1 of the Labour Code, by establishing an employment relationship the employee undertakes to perform work of a specified type for the employer and under the employer's direction, at a place and time designated by the employer, and the employer undertakes to employ the worker for remuneration. Art. 22 § 1¹ of the Labour Code provides that employment under such conditions is employment on the basis of an employment relationship regardless of the name of the contract concluded by the parties. Art. 22 § 1² of the Labour Code prohibits replacing an employment contract with a civil-law contract while maintaining the conditions of work characteristic of an employment relationship.
strings.O kwalifikacji decyduje więc rzeczywisty: It is therefore the actual manner of performing the work, not the title of the document, that determines the classification. Labour court case-law identifies features indicating an employment relationship: subordination to instructions (direction), a designated place and time of work, personal performance of the work, continuity and repetitiveness, and risk borne by the employer. In the courier model, factors such as the imposition of schedules/zones, a system of penalties and bonuses, and control via an app are often significant. The assessment is always individual — which is why the same scheme at two companies may be assessed differently.
strings.3. Skutki przekwalifikowania: zwolnienia: 3. Consequences of reclassification: collective redundancies, contributions, courses of action
strings.Jeżeli okaże się, że kurierzy powinni by: If it turns out that the couriers should have been employed under an employment contract, the protective mechanisms of labour law come into play. Below are the most important scenarios and the courses such a case usually takes:
strings.<strong>Ustalenie istnienia stosunku pra: Establishing the existence of an employment relationship — an employee (or former contractor) may bring an action to establish the existence of an employment relationship (Art. 189 of the Code of Civil Procedure in conjunction with Art. 22 of the Labour Code); such an action may also be brought by a labour inspector (Art. 63¹ of the Code of Civil Procedure).
strings.<strong>Działania PIP</strong> — inspekt: Labour Inspectorate action — an inspector may issue a demand/order to remedy the violations. The legislator is expanding the Labour Inspectorate's powers towards converting civil-law contracts into employment contracts; the scope and procedure (including any administrative decision) should be verified against the current wording of the Act on the National Labour Inspectorate, as the provisions in this area have been amended.
strings.<strong>Zwolnienia grupowe</strong> — gd: Collective redundancies — if the couriers were employees, the Act of 13 March 2003 on the specific rules for terminating employment relationships with employees for reasons not attributable to the employees would apply to mass dismissals (including the obligation to consult trade unions and pay severance).
strings.<strong>Składki ZUS</strong> — ZUS może: ZUS contributions — ZUS may determine the proper insurance title; if irregularities are found, it may claim overdue contributions retroactively (the limitation period for contribution claims is generally 5 years).
strings.<strong>Ryzyko i terminy:</strong> rozwi: Risk and time limits: the termination or expiry of a civil-law contract during an inspection does not close the path to establishing an employment relationship. Claims arising from an employment relationship generally lapse after 3 years (Art. 291 § 1 of the Labour Code), and ZUS contribution claims after 5 years. Specific time limits depend on the circumstances and require individual analysis.
strings.4. Co to oznacza dla cudzoziemców-kurier: 4. What it means for foreign couriers — risk assessment
strings.Dla kuriera będącego cudzoziemcem sprawa: For a courier who is a foreigner, the matter has an additional dimension — the legality of work and stay. The basis and conditions of performing work (type of contract, position, remuneration, working time) are usually reflected in the document legalising the work (declaration on entrusting work, work permit, single permit for residence and work). A change in the employment model — e.g. moving from a "mandate" to an employment contract or transfer to another entity (a "fleet partner") — may require updating these documents.
strings.<strong>Zmiana pracodawcy/podmiotu</stro: Change of employer/entity — if the courier is to be employed by an entrepreneur other than the one indicated in the legalisation document, a new basis for legalising the work is often required; work outside its scope risks an allegation of illegal entrustment/performance of work.
strings.<strong>Zmiana warunków</strong> — obniż: Change of conditions — reducing the remuneration or changing the working time below the conditions entered in the permit may require an amendment of the permit; it is worth checking this before signing a new contract.
strings.<strong>Przekwalifikowanie na umowę o pr: Reclassification into an employment contract — is generally beneficial (labour-law protection, contributions, seniority), but affects settlements and formalities; it should not deprive the foreigner of a legal basis for work, provided the documents are properly updated.
strings.Ocena ryzyka jest indywidualna i zależy: The risk assessment is individual and depends on the residence title held, the content of the document legalising the work and the details of the new contract. Before accepting a "re-employment" offer, it is worth consulting the specific terms with a lawyer so as not to lose the legality of work or waive the claims to which you are entitled.
strings.Pokaż więcej: dyrektywa o pracy platform: Show more: the platform work directive and the presumption of employment
strings.Na poziomie UE przyjęto dyrektywę w spra: At EU level, a directive on improving working conditions in platform work has been adopted (Directive (EU) 2024/2831 of the European Parliament and of the Council — the number and details should be verified in the Official Journal of the EU). Among other things, it introduces a mechanism of a legal presumption of an employment relationship and rules on algorithmic management. Member States have time to transpose it into national law — according to announcements by the labour ministry, work on the Polish implementing act is ongoing; the final shape and date of entry into force require ongoing verification.
strings.Kierunek zmian jest jasny: rośnie ochron: The direction of change is clear: protection is growing for people working for platforms, including those employed through intermediaries. For companies this means a greater risk of contract reclassification and sanctions; for couriers, a real chance of employee status. Foreigners, however, should ensure that every change in the employment model is accompanied by an update of the documents legalising their work.

strings.10 najczęstszych błędów we wniosku MOS —: The 10 most common errors in a MOS application — and how not to lose your legal stay because of them
strings.Ostatnia aktualizacja: 7 lipca 2026 · Au: Last updated: 7 July 2026 · Author: the TRC Law Firm team · Reading time: approx. 7 min
strings.Elektroniczny wniosek w MOS nie wybacza: An electronic application in MOS does not forgive carelessness. Formal deficiencies mean a summons to supplement them, and in the worst scenario — leaving the application without examination, that is a situation in which the case is not pending at all and the legality of your stay hangs by a thread. Here are the errors we see most often in the firm's practice.
strings.1. Złożenie wniosku po terminie legalneg: 1. Filing the application after the legal stay has expired
strings.Wniosek złożony choćby dzień po upływie: An application filed even one day after the legal stay (visa, visa-free travel, previous card) has expired does not produce the „legalising” effect of awaiting a decision and exposes you to a return obligation.
strings.✓ Złóż wniosek najpóźniej ostatniego dni: ✓ File the application at the latest on the last day of your legal stay — the UPO from MOS confirms the date.
strings.2. Brak podpisu elektronicznego lub błąd: 2. Missing electronic signature or an error when signing
strings.Wniosek wypełniony, ale niepodpisany (al: An application that is completed but unsigned (or signed incorrectly) has not been effectively filed.
strings.✓ Po wysłaniu zawsze pobierz i zachowaj: ✓ After sending, always download and keep the UPO. No UPO = no proof of filing.
strings.3. Brak załącznika nr 1 od pracodawcy (z: 3. Missing annex no. 1 from the employer (single permit)
strings.Pracodawca musi podpisać elektronicznie: The employer must electronically sign annex no. 1 via a link received by e-mail. An unaware employer who ignores the message blocks the entire case.
strings.✓ Uprzedź pracodawcę i zweryfikuj, że po: ✓ Warn your employer in advance and verify that they signed the annex before the deadline.
strings.Ucięte strony paszportu, nieczytelne umo: Cropped passport pages, illegible contracts, a photo that does not meet the requirements — these are classic reasons for summonses to supplement the file.
strings.✓ Skanuj wszystkie zapisane strony paszp: ✓ Scan every used page of your passport in good resolution; check each file before sending.
strings.Inna pisownia nazwiska w paszporcie, PES: A different spelling of your surname in the passport, the PESEL register and the employment contract raises doubts at the office and prolongs the proceedings.
strings.✓ Ujednolić pisownię we wszystkich dokum: ✓ Unify the spelling in all documents in line with the passport — before you file the application.
strings.6. Brak opłaty skarbowej lub zły rachune: 6. No stamp duty paid or the wrong office account
strings.✓ Opłać właściwą kwotę na rachunek urzęd: ✓ Pay the correct amount to the account of the city office competent for the voivode's seat and attach the confirmation.
Choosing the wrong residence basis (e.g. „work” instead of „business activity”, an ordinary temporary residence instead of the EU Blue Card) means, at best, the loss of months.
strings.✓ Przy nietypowej sytuacji (zmiana praco: ✓ In an atypical situation (change of employer, own business, family) consult the choice of procedure with a lawyer.
strings.8. Nieaktualny adres do doręczeń i nieod: 8. Outdated address for service and failure to collect correspondence
strings.Wezwania doręczone na stary adres (lub e: Summonses served to an old address (or electronically but not read) are deemed served — the time limits run.
strings.✓ Aktualizuj adres, regularnie sprawdzaj: ✓ Update your address, regularly check your MOS account and your e-mail inbox.
strings.9. Przegapienie terminu na uzupełnienie: 9. Missing the deadline to supplement deficiencies
strings.Urząd wyznacza termin (zwykle co najmnie: The office sets a time limit (usually at least 7 days) to supplement formal deficiencies. Exceeding it = leaving the application without examination.
strings.✓ Reaguj natychmiast; jeśli potrzebujesz: ✓ React immediately; if you need more time, file a request to extend the deadline before it expires.
strings.Odciski palców są niezbędne do wydania k: Fingerprints are essential for the card to be issued. Ignoring the summons halts the case.
strings.✓ Stają się na wezwanie z paszportem; w: ✓ Appear when summoned, with your passport; if the date clashes — request a change in advance.
strings.<strong>Pozostawienie bez rozpoznania —: Leaving without examination — what does it mean? The office does not issue a refusal decision, it simply does not examine the case at all. There is no ordinary appeal against it, and the „waiting” period does not legalise your stay. Often the only way out is a new application — provided your stay is still legal.
strings.Wolisz mieć pewność za pierwszym razem?: Would you rather be sure the first time?

strings.1. Co to jest MOS i kogo dotyczy: 1. What MOS is and who it applies to
strings.MOS (Moduł Obsługi Spraw) to rządowy por: MOS (Moduł Obsługi Spraw — Case Handling Module) is a government online portal available at mos.cudzoziemcy.gov.pl, through which foreigners file residence applications to voivodes. From 27 April 2026, applications for a temporary residence permit, permanent residence permit and long-term EU resident permit are filed exclusively electronically via MOS.
strings.<strong>Uwaga:</strong> wniosek papierow: Note: a paper application filed after 26 April 2026 is left without examination — regardless of the postal dispatch date. This means the authority will not deal with your case at all, and your stay may become illegal.
strings.2. Co przygotować przed złożeniem wniosk: 2. What to prepare before filing the application
strings.<strong>Środek identyfikacji elektronicz: An electronic identification means — logging into MOS takes place via login.gov.pl: Trusted Profile, e-ID or electronic banking. If you do not have a Trusted Profile, read our guide: Trusted Profile for a foreigner.
strings.<strong>Ważny dokument podróży (paszport: A valid travel document (passport) — a scan of all pages containing entries.
strings.<strong>Aktualna fotografia</strong> zgo: A current photograph meeting the requirements (as for an identity card).
strings.<strong>Dokumenty potwierdzające cel pob: Documents confirming the purpose of stay — e.g. employment contract, annex no. 1 from the employer, university certificate, marriage certificate.
strings.<strong>Dokumenty dodatkowe</strong> — u: Additional documents — health insurance, confirmation of place of residence, source of stable income (depending on the type of permit).
strings.<strong>Potwierdzenie opłaty skarbowej</: Confirmation of payment of the stamp duty for issuing the permit.
strings.<strong>Ważne dla pracujących:</strong>: Important for those in employment: if you are applying for a single permit (temporary residence and work), your employer completes and signs annex no. 1 electronically — the system sends them a link by e-mail. Let your employer know in advance, because without their signature the application is incomplete.
strings.3. Złożenie wniosku krok po kroku: 3. Filing the application step by step
strings.<strong>Zaloguj się do MOS</strong> — we: Log in to MOS — go to mos.cudzoziemcy.gov.pl and log in via login.gov.pl (Trusted Profile, e-ID or bank).
strings.<strong>Wybierz rodzaj sprawy</strong> —: Choose the type of case — e.g. a temporary residence and work permit. The system will guide you through the relevant form. The form is available in Polish only.
strings.<strong>Wypełnij formularz</strong> — da: Complete the form — personal data, travel document data, purpose of stay, residence and travel history. Fields marked with an asterisk are mandatory; the system indicates validation errors.
strings.<strong>Dodaj załączniki</strong> — skan: Add attachments — scans of documents in the required formats. Check that each file is legible before sending.
strings.<strong>Podpisz wniosek elektronicznie</: Sign the application electronically — with a Trusted Profile, a qualified signature or a personal signature (e-ID).
strings.<strong>Wyślij i pobierz UPO</strong> —: Send it and download the UPO — after sending you will receive an Official Confirmation of Receipt. Keep it — it is proof of the date the application was filed.
strings.4. Co dzieje się po złożeniu wniosku: 4. What happens after filing the application
strings.Urząd wojewódzki weryfikuje wniosek pod: The voivodship office verifies the application in formal terms. If you filed it on time (during legal stay) and there are no formal deficiencies, your stay is legal until the day the final decision is served. strings.Przepisy przewidują szczególny mechanizm: The law provides a special mechanism: an employee's income from illegal employment may be exempt from PIT on the employee's side, and the tax burden and additional consequences are shifted to the employer (Art. 21(1)(151) of the PIT Act together with related provisions).

strings.Nielegalne zatrudnienie. Jaka kara? — wy: Illegal employment. What penalty? — Supreme Court judgment (I PKN 558/99)
strings.Data publikacji: 28 lipca 2026 · Autor:: Date of publication: 28 July 2026 · Author: Dariusz Włodarczyk Kancelaria TRC · Reading time: approx. 6 min
strings.Pracodawca zatrudnia cudzoziemca bez zez: An employer employs a foreigner without a permit and without a written contract. The foreigner actually works — and then demands remuneration. The employer defends itself with the argument: "since there was no permit, the contract is void, so nothing is owed". Is the employer right? The Supreme Court, in its judgment of 27 March 2000 (ref. I PKN 558/99), resolved this question unequivocally. Below: a brief statement of facts, the indicated violations, the content of the judgment, and what penalties for illegal employment apply today.
strings.<a href=\"#sek2\">Naruszenie — na czym p: The violation — what the legal dispute was about
strings.<a href=\"#sek3\">Wyrok SN i jego uzasad: The Supreme Court judgment and its reasoning
strings.Sprawa dotyczyła powództwa cudzoziemca (: The case concerned an action by a foreigner (in the judgment: Henny L.) against an employer (Janusz L.) for remuneration for work. On 15 December 1994 the parties concluded a contract which the courts recognised as a preliminary contract: the claimant was to be employed from 1 March 1995 as sales director, and the condition of employment was obtaining the consent of the labour office. The contract also provided (in § 4) for the rules of remuneration for work performed before signing the proper employment contract — on the basis of a mandate contract, with a 50/50 split of net profit.
strings.Pracodawca o zezwolenie na zatrudnienie: The employer applied for a permit to employ the foreigner only on 27 February 1995 — a few days before the agreed date. The application had formal defects, so the permit was not issued until 20 April 1995. Nevertheless, from 1 March 1995 — without the required permit and consent — the claimant actually started work as sales director and performed it until 31 May 1995. This was confirmed by witnesses and by company documents signed by the claimant.
strings.2. Naruszenie — na czym polegał spór pra: 2. The violation — what the legal dispute was about
strings.Kluczowe pytanie brzmiało: czy zatrudnie: The key question was: does the employment of a foreigner without the required permit (on the employer's side) and consent of the labour office (on the foreigner's side) cause the absolute nullity of the employment contract under Art. 58 § 1 of the Civil Code (a legal act contrary to the law is void), applied to employment relationships through Art. 300 of the Labour Code?
strings.Pracodawca (skarżący) opierał kasację na: The employer (the appellant) based its cassation on Art. 50 of the then Act of 14 December 1994 on employment and counteracting unemployment, arguing that since the provision prohibited employing a foreigner without a permit, a contract concluded in breach of it is void — and if there was no employment contract, the three-year limitation period under Art. 291 of the Labour Code does not apply and the claim should be assessed differently. The essence of the dispute was therefore whether "illegal employment" entails the automatic invalidation of the contract, or whether the contract remains valid and the illegality gives rise only to other consequences (e.g. criminal and administrative).
strings.3. Wyrok SN i jego uzasadnienie: 3. The Supreme Court judgment and its reasoning
strings.Sąd Najwyższy <strong>oddalił kasację pr: The Supreme Court dismissed the employer's cassation, adopting the thesis: the sanction of nullity (Art. 58 of the Civil Code) does not apply to an employment contract with a foreigner concluded without the required permit or consent of the labour office. The contract is valid, and since the work was actually performed — remuneration is owed.
strings.Sąd oparł to stanowisko na kilku argumen: The Court based this position on several arguments:
strings.<strong>Art. 58 KC stosuje się do prawa: Art. 58 of the Civil Code applies to labour law only accordingly. Through Art. 300 of the Labour Code it is invoked only in matters not regulated by labour law and without infringing the principles of that law. One should strive to eliminate cases of absolute nullity of a contract where the legal relationship has all the features of an employment relationship and the work was actually performed.
strings.<strong>„Nielegalne zatrudnienie\" ≠ nie: "Illegal employment" ≠ nullity of the contract. Employing a foreigner without a permit is indeed a case of illegal employment (Art. 2(1)(9) of the act), but the same concept also covers, for instance, employment without concluding a written employment contract — and a breach of the written form does not, after all, invalidate the contract. By analogy, the absence of a permit does not in itself invalidate the contract.
strings.<strong>Sankcją jest grzywna, nie nieważ: The sanction is a fine, not nullity. Employing a foreigner without a permit was punishable by a fine (Art. 64 of the act), and alongside it there were other measures (e.g. deprivation of a visa, expulsion from the country). These sanctions are sufficient to protect the labour market — without the need to assume that the absence of a permit nullifies the contract.
strings.<strong>Zakaz adresowany do pracodawcy,: The prohibition is addressed to the employer, not to both parties. The requirement under Art. 50(1) of the act was directed at the employer — it is the employer who may not employ a foreigner without a permit. It cannot be extended to both parties and used to infer the nullity of the contract.
strings.<strong>Ustawa zakładała istnienie stosu: The act assumed the existence of an employment relationship despite the absence of a permit. It followed from Art. 50(7) that withdrawal of the permit obliges the employer to terminate the contract within 3 days — so the contract does not expire by operation of law, but continues until terminated according to the rules of labour law.
strings.<strong>Funkcja ochronna prawa pracy.</s: The protective function of labour law. The Supreme Court stressed that when an employer accepts the performance of work, the consequences of illegal employment should not be shifted onto the employee. The burden of the breach falls on the one who employed illegally — a foreigner who actually worked cannot be deprived of remuneration solely because the employer failed to complete the formalities.
strings.Wyrok zapadł na tle nieobowiązującej już: The judgment was issued against the background of the now-repealed 1994 act, but its essential idea remains relevant: illegal entrustment of work to a foreigner is punishable primarily by a penalty (fine) on the employer's side, not by automatic invalidation of the contract and deprivation of the employee's remuneration for work already performed. For the employer this means a double risk: a public-law sanction and the obligation to pay for the work performed.
strings.Stan prawny się jednak zmienił. Od 1 cze: The legal situation has, however, changed. Since 1 June 2025, the Act of 20 March 2025 on the conditions for the admissibility of entrusting work to foreigners in the territory of the Republic of Poland has been in force, replacing the previous provisions of the Act on the promotion of employment. According to data from the National Labour Inspectorate, the new act tightened the sanctions: the fine for illegal entrustment of work to a foreigner now falls within the range of PLN 3,000 to 50,000 (previously PLN 1,000 to 30,000), and its amount is graduated by, among other things, the number of foreigners to whom work was illegally entrusted.
strings.<strong>Zastrzeżenie co do stanu prawneg: Reservation as to the legal situation. The above range and date of entry into force come from Labour Inspectorate announcements and industry publications of 2025 — before relying on a specific amount, the current wording of the Act of 20 March 2025 (in particular the provision on the amount of the fine) should be verified in the official text in the Journal of Laws. Separate, more far-reaching consequences (including criminal ones and a ban on applying for permits) may arise from entrusting work to a foreigner staying in Poland illegally — this is a separate regime that requires individual analysis.
strings.Praktyczny wniosek dla obu stron. <stron: Practical conclusion for both parties. A foreigner who actually performed the work generally retains the claim to remuneration, even if the employer did not arrange the permit — the lack of formalities does not "cancel" the work performed. An employer will not avoid payment by invoking its own negligence, and additionally exposes itself to a fine and other sanctions. It is safest to complete the formalities before admitting the foreigner to work — the order "first the permit/authorisation, then the work" protects both parties.

strings.To, czy jesteś rezydentem, czy nierezyde: Whether you are a resident or a non-resident determines the scope of Polish tax. We explain the difference between unlimited and limited tax liability and what counts as income earned in Poland.
strings.Polski PIT rozróżnia dwa reżimy. <strong: Polish PIT distinguishes two regimes. Unlimited tax liability (Article 3(1) of the PIT Act) applies to residents — their entire worldwide income is taxed. Limited tax liability (Article 3(2a)) applies to non-residents — only income earned on Polish territory.
strings.Art. 3 ust. 2b ustawy o PIT wskazuje prz: Article 3(2b) of the PIT Act lists examples of income sources treated as earned in Poland, including work performed on Polish territory (regardless of where the payment is made), business activity conducted in Poland and real property located in Poland. This is an open-ended list.
strings.<strong>Praktyka:</strong> cudzoziemiec-: In practice: a non-resident foreigner physically working in Poland will pay Polish tax on that work, even if the salary is transferred by a foreign entity.
strings.Dochody ze stosunku pracy co do zasady o: Income from employment is as a rule taxed under the tax scale. For certain payments made to non-residents, a flat-rate withholding tax may apply. Whether more favourable rules under a double taxation treaty apply depends, among other things, on a certificate of residence.

strings.Pracodawca nie oddaje Ci dokumentów do k: Your employer will not return your residence card documents? This is not a minor inconvenience — without them you may fail to answer a summons from the authority, be unable to change jobs and genuinely lose your legal stay. The good news: documents held by an employer can be recovered, and the sooner you start, the more options you have. Below is a step-by-step action plan.

strings.<a href=\"#sek2\">Co robić krok po kroku: What to do step by step when the employer withholds documents?
strings.<a href=\"#sek3\">Czy prawnik dla cudzoz: Will a lawyer for foreigners recover the documents faster?

strings.1. Dlaczego brak dokumentów od pracodawc: 1. Why is the lack of documents from your employer dangerous for your residence card?
strings.Wniosek o pobyt czasowy i pracę opiera s: An application for temporary residence and work is based on employment documents: the contract, the employer's annex, confirmations of registration with ZUS. When you have no access to them, you lose control over your own case — and in residence proceedings time matters. A summons to remedy formal shortcomings has a strict deadline, and missing it may mean that the application is left without examination (Article 64 § 2 of the Code of Administrative Procedure).
strings.<strong>Pamiętaj:</strong> dokumenty dot: Remember: documents concerning your employment and your residence case concern you. You have the right to copies of them — regardless of how your relations with the company are going.
strings.2. Co robić krok po kroku, gdy pracodawc: 2. What to do step by step when the employer withholds documents?
strings.Działaj spokojnie, ale konsekwentnie i z: Act calmly, but consistently and always in writing:
strings.poproś pracodawcę <strong>na piśmie</str: ask the employer in writing (an e-mail is enough) to release all documents concerning your employment and your residence case,
strings.zachowaj wiadomości, e-maile i zrzuty ek: keep messages, e-mails and screenshots of conversations — this is evidence in case of a dispute,
strings.zrób listę braków: umowa, załącznik prac: make a list of what is missing: the contract, the employer's annex to the application, confirmation of filing the application (UPO), payslips, ZUS registration,
strings.nie czekaj, jeśli firma unika odpowiedzi: do not wait if the company avoids answering — every week of delay works against you,
strings.przy świadectwie pracy pamiętaj, że jego: as for the work certificate, remember that issuing it is the employer's obligation under Article 97 of the Labour Code.
strings.3. Czy prawnik dla cudzoziemca odzyska d: 3. Will a lawyer for foreigners recover the documents faster?
strings.Zwykle tak. Formalne wezwanie od pełnomo: Usually yes. A formal request from a legal representative works differently from an employee's request — it shows that the matter is being monitored and that continuing to withhold the documents creates risk for the company. An independent lawyer will also assess immediately whether your case requires a new application, a change of permit or a letter to the authority — before the deadline passes. If you are planning to change jobs, remember the obligation to notify the voivode within 15 working days of losing your job (Act on Foreigners; the exact numbering of the provision should be verified against the current text of the act).
strings.<strong>Termin 15 dni.</strong> Po utrac: The 15-day deadline. After losing your job the clock is ticking regardless of whether you have the documents. Failing to notify on time may weigh on your residence case.
strings.4. Jak się zabezpieczyć na przyszłość?: 4. How to protect yourself in the future?
strings.Najbezpieczniejszy układ jest prosty: pr: The safest arrangement is simple: the employer provides the certificates, and the whole case is handled by a representative independent of the company — then the documents and correspondence are always with you. If you are wondering whom to entrust with your case, see our comparison: who should handle your residence card — a lawyer or an employer. And if the documents are already stuck with the company, read also: how to recover residence card documents and what to do when you have not received a summons from the authority.
strings.Czy pracodawca może legalnie zatrzymać m: Can the employer legally keep my documents?
strings.Nie ma podstawy, by pracodawca odmawiał: There is no basis for an employer to refuse you copies of documents concerning your employment and your residence case. The work certificate must be issued by operation of law (Article 97 of the Labour Code), and the documents of the residence case concern you as a party to the proceedings.
strings.Co jeśli pracodawca ignoruje moje prośby: What if the employer ignores my requests for documents?
strings.Przejdź na formę pisemną i zachowuj dowo: Switch to written form and keep the evidence. If that does not work, a formal request from a legal representative usually speeds things up. At the same time, take care of the deadlines at the authority — the lack of documents does not stop time running.
strings.Czy bez dokumentów od pracodawcy mogę zm: Can I change jobs without documents from my employer?
strings.Możesz, ale wymaga to odpowiednich krokó: You can, but it requires the appropriate steps towards the voivode and keeping to the deadlines (including 15 working days to notify the loss of your job). See the article on changing employer and the residence card in our series.

strings.Pracownik delegowany z UE do Polski — gd: Worker posted from the EU to Poland — where contributions are paid
strings.Gdy zagraniczna firma z UE deleguje prac: When a foreign company from the EU posts a worker to Poland, contributions usually remain abroad. We explain the role of the A1 form, health matters and the obligations of both companies.
strings.Pracownik <strong>delegowany</strong> to: A posted worker is a person sent temporarily to work in another country by an employer established in the sending country. For posting from the EU/EEA/Switzerland to Poland, the applicability of contributions is determined by EU coordination.
strings.Co do zasady pracownik delegowany pozost: As a rule, a posted worker remains insured in the sending country on the basis of an A1 — despite working in Poland. Without a valid A1, there is a risk of being subject to contributions in Poland.
strings.<strong>Zdrowotne:</strong> dostęp do św: Health: access to benefits for a posted worker is confirmed by coordination documents (e.g. EHIC). The Polish health contribution is then usually not due.
strings.3. Obowiązki po stronie firm: 3. Obligations on the part of the companies
strings.Zarówno pracodawca wysyłający, jak i pod: Both the sending employer and the host entity should ensure proper posting documentation (A1, working conditions). This is also relevant in a possible inspection.

strings.Rezydencja podatkowa cudzoziemca w Polsc: Tax residence of a foreigner in Poland — the 183-day rule and the centre of vital interests
strings.Data publikacji: 29 lipca 2026 · Autor:: Published: 29 July 2026 · Author: Dariusz Włodarczyk Kancelaria TRC · Reading time: approx. 8 min
strings.Rezydencja podatkowa decyduje o tym, od: Tax residence determines which income you pay tax on in Poland. We explain when a foreigner becomes a Polish resident, how unlimited and limited tax liability differ and what this means for the HR department.
strings.<a href=\"#kiedy\">Kiedy jesteś polskim: When you are a Polish resident
strings.<a href=\"#dni\">Reguła 183 dni i ośrode: The 183-day rule and the centre of interests
strings.<a href=\"#kadry\">Podwójna rezydencja i: Dual residence and what it means for HR
strings.1. Kiedy jesteś polskim rezydentem podat: 1. When you are a Polish tax resident
strings.Zgodnie z <strong>art. 3 ust. 1a ustawy: Under Article 3(1a) of the Personal Income Tax Act (the PIT Act), a person is deemed to have their place of residence in Poland if they meet at least one of the conditions: they have their centre of personal or economic interests (centre of vital interests) in Poland, or they stay in Poland for more than 183 days in the tax year. The conditions are joined by "or" — one is enough.
strings.<strong>Uwaga:</strong> rezydencja podat: Note: tax residence is not the same as citizenship or a residence card. Residence is determined solely by the criteria set out in the PIT Act.
strings.2. Reguła 183 dni i ośrodek interesów ży: 2. The 183-day rule and the centre of vital interests
strings.Do limitu 183 dni wlicza się <strong>każ: The 183-day limit counts every day of physical presence in Poland in the calendar year — including the day of arrival and departure as well as weekends and holidays. In practice, however, the centre of vital interests is often more important than the number of days: if your centre of personal (family) and economic (work, assets, income) affairs is in Poland, you may be a resident even with a shorter stay.
strings.4. Podwójna rezydencja i znaczenie dla k: 4. Dual residence and what it means for HR
strings.Gdy dwa państwa uznają Cię za rezydenta,: When two countries consider you a resident, the conflict is resolved by the double taxation treaty (DTT) and its tie-breaker rules. Applying a DTT usually requires a certificate of residence. For the HR department, residence status affects the withholding of PIT advances — establish it with the employee in writing at the start of employment.
strings.<strong>Do weryfikacji indywidualnie:</s: To be verified individually: the details of advance-payment withholding depend on the type of contract and on the wording of the particular DTT. Confirm with your accounting department or tax adviser.
strings.Pokaż więcej: kiedy warto zgłębić temat: Show more: when it is worth looking into residence in depth
strings.<strong>Pobyt &lt; 183 dni, rodzina za g: Stay < 183 days, family abroad: usually a non-resident (low risk). Stay > 183 days, family abroad: dual residence possible — resolved by the DTT (medium risk; a certificate of residence is advisable). Moving with the family: usually a resident from the moment the centre of life is transferred, with possible "split-year residence" (risk of misreporting foreign income).
strings.Jak udokumentować ośrodek interesów: How to document the centre of interests
strings.Warto gromadzić dowody: umowę o pracę i: It is worth gathering evidence: the employment contract and place of work, a lease agreement or title deed, bills, proof of the family's stay, insurance. In a dispute with the authority, these are the first circumstances you will rely on.

strings.Równowaga płci w organach spółek publicz: Gender balance on the boards of public companies — what does the government bill provide?
strings.Rada Ministrów 9 czerwca 2026 r. przyjęł: On 9 June 2026 the Council of Ministers adopted a bill intended to improve gender balance in the governing bodies of public companies established in Poland. The bill transposes EU Directive 2022/2381 into national law and introduces a threshold of at least 33% representation of the under-represented sex on the management and supervisory boards of the largest listed companies. Below we explain who the rules will cover, what obligations they impose — including on foreigners sitting on company bodies — and we assess the risks connected with the new rules.
strings.<a href=\"#sek1\">Czego dotyczy projekt: What the bill concerns and its legal basis
strings.<a href=\"#sek2\">Kogo obejmą nowe przep: Who the new rules will cover
strings.<a href=\"#sek3\">Kluczowe obowiązki spó: Key obligations of companies and possible courses of action
strings.1. Czego dotyczy projekt i jaka jest pod: 1. What the bill concerns and its legal basis
strings.Projekt przyjęty przez Radę Ministrów 9: The bill adopted by the Council of Ministers on 9 June 2026 transposes into the Polish legal order Directive (EU) 2022/2381 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 23 November 2022 on improving the gender balance among directors of listed companies and related measures (the "Women on Boards" initiative). According to the Ministry of Justice, the changes are intended to increase the participation of women and men in the decision-making of the largest listed firms through transparent rules for selecting members of management and supervisory boards.
strings.Nowelizacja ma zmienić m.in. ustawę o of: The amendment is to modify, among others, the Act on public offering and the conditions for introducing financial instruments to an organised trading system and on public companies, as well as the Act on the implementation of certain EU provisions on equal treatment. At the heart of the regulation is the goal that at least one third (33%) of the posts on the management and supervisory boards of large listed companies be held by persons of the under-represented sex.
strings.<strong>Uwaga dla cudzoziemców.</strong>: Note for foreigners. The rules refer to sex, not to citizenship — they therefore cover every member of and candidate for a company body, regardless of nationality. Foreigners sitting on, or standing for, the management and supervisory boards of Polish listed companies will be subject to the same selection and reporting rules as Polish citizens.
strings.2. Kogo obejmą nowe przepisy: 2. Who the new rules will cover
The regulation does not concern all companies. According to the Ministry of Justice, the new rules will cover large listed companies that jointly:
strings.osiągają roczny obrót powyżej 50 mln eur: achieve an annual turnover of more than EUR 50 million or have a total annual balance sheet exceeding EUR 43 million.
strings.Mikro-, małe i średnie przedsiębiorstwa: Micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) will remain outside the scope of the regulation. Media estimates suggest that the rules will affect about 200 entities — this figure should be treated as approximate and verified in the regulatory impact assessment attached to the bill.
strings.3. Kluczowe obowiązki spółek i możliwe w: 3. Key obligations of companies and possible courses of action
strings.Projekt nakłada na objęte nim spółki kil: The bill imposes several interrelated obligations on the companies it covers. Below we discuss them together with possible ways of adapting — the final shape depends on the wording of the act passed by the Sejm and the Senate.
strings.Docelowy udział płci niedostatecznie rep: Target share of the under-represented sex
strings.Spółka musi dążyć do co najmniej 33% udz: A company must aim for at least a 33% share of the under-represented sex on its bodies. In practice this means two main routes: gradually filling the composition through the natural rotation of terms, or actively planning succession and building a candidate list in advance so that the target is reached without disruption to the staffing of the bodies.
strings.Spółki mają stosować jasne i neutralne k: Companies are to apply clear and neutral criteria for selecting candidates. Where two or more candidates have comparable qualifications, priority goes to the person of the under-represented sex — unless objective criteria favour the candidate of the opposite sex. This solution requires documenting the recruitment process so that, in the event of a dispute, the company can demonstrate the objectivity of its decision.
strings.Walne zgromadzenie akcjonariuszy będzie: The general meeting of shareholders will have to adopt — by resolution — a gender-balance policy, and the management board will have to draw up and publish each year a report on the participation of women and men in the bodies and on the measures taken. As an option, companies may integrate this reporting into their existing non-financial/ESG reporting or keep it as a separate document.
strings.<strong>Ryzyko i sankcje.</strong> Proje: Risk and sanctions. The bill provides for supervision of compliance and financial penalties of up to PLN 500,000 for failure to meet the obligations relating to the gender-balance policy. Candidates who consider that these requirements were breached in the recruitment process will be able to pursue claims in court, including seeking compensation.
strings.Na dzień publikacji tego materiału mamy: As at the date of publication of this material, we are dealing with a bill — a document adopted by the Council of Ministers on 9 June 2026 which, before entering into force, must still pass through the parliamentary process (Sejm, Senate) and be signed by the President. This means that the detailed solutions, thresholds and sanctions may still change. The act is to enter into force 14 days after its publication in the Journal of Laws. The adaptation deadlines and any transitional periods should be verified in the final text of the act.
strings.Główne ryzyka praktyczne to: kary finans: The main practical risks are: financial penalties of up to PLN 500,000, compensation claims from passed-over candidates and reputational risk in the event of missing required reporting. We recommend that companies potentially covered by the regulation analyse the composition of their bodies and their nomination procedures now, and that foreigners sitting on, or standing for, governing bodies consult their status and documentation with a lawyer. Given the stage of the legislative work, every decision should be based on the current wording of the bill and, ultimately, of the enacted act.

strings.Zatrudnienie cudzoziemca a umowa na czas: Employment of a foreigner and an indefinite-term contract — Supreme Court judgment (III PK 11/16)
strings.Data publikacji: 28 lipca 2026 · Autor:: Date of publication: 28 July 2026 · Author: Dariusz Włodarczyk Kancelaria TRC · Reading time: approx. 7 min
strings.Czy cudzoziemca spoza Unii Europejskiej: May a non-EU foreigner be employed "automatically" only on fixed-term contracts simply because they hold a temporary residence permit? And can citizenship alone justify worse treatment of an employee? The Supreme Court answered both questions in its judgment of 7 November 2016 (ref. III PK 11/16). This is an important ruling for every foreigner working legally in Poland. Below: a brief statement of facts, the breaches identified and the resolution.
strings.<a href=\"#sek2\">Naruszenia — na czym p: The breaches — where the courts went wrong
strings.<a href=\"#sek4\">Co z tego wynika dla c: What this means for foreigners — risk assessment
strings.Powódka — obywatelka Ukrainy — była zatr: The claimant — a Ukrainian citizen — was employed at a public lower-secondary school (previously: a group of public schools) as a teacher of English. She took up the work at the invitation of the district authorities as part of a town-twinning cooperation; previously she had taught English for 5 years at a school in Ukraine. For about 12 years she was employed under successive fixed-term contracts of employment, each time holding a residence permit (fixed-term residence) and — depending on the legal situation at the time — a work permit.
strings.Ostatnia umowa, zawarta 22 sierpnia 2011: The last contract, concluded on 22 August 2011, covered a two-year period, until 31 August 2013. For the 2013/2014 school year, the available English-language hours (the reported vacancy) were assigned to another, newly hired teacher — a Polish citizen — and no further contract was concluded with the claimant.
strings.Powódka wystąpiła do sądu z trzema roszc: The claimant brought three claims before the court: for compensation (PLN 6,400) for breach of the principle of equal treatment in employment (Article 183a of the Labour Code), for a determination of the content of the employment relationship (Article 189 of the Code of Civil Procedure) and for reinstatement. The District Court dismissed the action and the Regional Court dismissed the appeal. Both courts held that, since the claimant held only a temporary residence permit (granted for a period of no more than 2 years), an indefinite-term contract could not be concluded with her, and that different treatment on grounds of citizenship (Ukraine — a non-EU state) was permissible.
strings.<strong>Dwa sporne zagadnienia.</strong>: Two contested issues. First — whether the temporary nature of the residence permit in itself justifies concluding fixed-term contracts with a foreign teacher. Second — whether citizenship may be a permissible criterion differentiating an employee's situation, even though it is not expressly listed in the Labour Code's catalogue of discriminatory criteria.
strings.2. Naruszenia — na czym pomyliły się sąd: 2. The breaches — where the courts went wrong
strings.Sąd Najwyższy uznał skargę kasacyjną za: The Supreme Court found that the cassation appeal had well-founded grounds and pointed to errors in the reasoning of the lower courts on both issues.
strings.2.1. Czasowe zezwolenie na pobyt nie prz: 2.1. A temporary residence permit does not determine the type of contract
strings.SN wyjaśnił, że powódka — jako nauczycie: The Supreme Court explained that the claimant — as a foreign-language teacher at a school within the education system — was exempt from the requirement to obtain a work permit under § 1(3) of the Regulation of the Minister of Labour and Social Policy of 20 July 2011 (and, earlier, the corresponding Regulations of 2001 and 2006). The legality of her work therefore depended on legal residence, not on a separate work permit.
strings.Kluczowa teza: <strong>czasowe zezwoleni: Key thesis: a temporary residence permit does not preclude the conclusion of an indefinite-term contract. The Act of 20 April 2004 on employment promotion and labour market institutions — unlike the repealed Act on employment and counteracting unemployment (Article 50(9)) — no longer contains a provision requiring contracts to be concluded "for the duration of the granted permit". Moreover, in case the right of residence expires, the legislator provided the mechanism in Article 88g of that Act: the obligation to perform work expires when the foreigner ceases to meet the conditions of Article 87. An employer is therefore not forced to conclude fixed-term contracts in order to protect itself against the charge of illegal employment.
strings.<strong>Nauczyciel cudzoziemiec = te sam: A foreign teacher = the same rules as a Polish citizen. Under the Regulation of the Minister of National Education of 30 October 1992 and the Teacher's Charter, a foreigner employed as a foreign-language teacher in a public school must — as regards the type of contract concluded — be treated the same as a Polish citizen. The only express differentiation is Article 10(5) of the Teacher's Charter: nationals of "third" countries may not be employed on the basis of appointment.
strings.Wynika stąd, że o dopuszczalności umowy: It follows that the admissibility of a fixed-term contract is determined solely by whether the conditions of Article 10(7) of the Teacher's Charter are met — i.e. a need arising from the organisation of teaching or the replacement of an absent teacher — and not by the mere fact of holding a temporary residence permit. Concluding a fixed-term contract without meeting those conditions means that, in substance, an indefinite-term contract was concluded, and the teacher may seek a determination of the content of the employment relationship under Article 189 of the Code of Civil Procedure.
strings.2.2. Obywatelstwo jako niedozwolone kryt: 2.2. Citizenship as an impermissible criterion of discrimination
The second error concerned equal treatment. The courts assumed that different treatment of the claimant on grounds of citizenship was permissible, relying on the Act of 3 December 2010 on the implementation of certain EU provisions on equal treatment. The Supreme Court indicated that this was incorrect: under Article 2(2) of that Act, its provisions (Chapters 1 and 2) do not apply to employees — so it cannot justify differentiating an employee's situation.
strings.<strong>Kryterium obywatelstwa może być: Citizenship can be discrimination. The Labour Code (Article 113 and Article 183a § 1 of the Labour Code) lists nationality among the prohibited criteria but does not expressly list citizenship (the two concepts are not identical). The catalogue of criteria is, however, open, and therefore — as the Supreme Court held — in principle citizenship may be treated as an impermissible criterion of a directly discriminatory nature. A discriminatory criterion may in no case determine the type of employment contract concluded.
strings.SN podkreślił, że przepisom Kodeksu prac: The Supreme Court stressed that the Labour Code provisions on equal treatment apply not only to Polish and EU citizens but also to workers from "third" countries who hold an appropriate work or residence permit. The principle of non-discrimination is universal — it follows not only from EU law but also from international law (ILO conventions) and from Article 32 of the Constitution of the Republic of Poland; exceptions in respect of foreigners are laid down by statute (Article 37(2) of the Constitution).
strings.Sąd Najwyższy <strong>uchylił zaskarżony: The Supreme Court set aside the contested judgment of the Regional Court and referred the case back for re-examination (under Article 39815 § 1 of the Code of Civil Procedure), leaving that court to rule on the costs of the cassation proceedings. The case was therefore not finally resolved in the claimant's favour — but the Supreme Court indicated to the court the direction of further proceedings:
strings.przy ponownym rozpoznaniu należy ustalić: on re-examination it must be established whether there was in fact a need arising from the organisation of teaching or a replacement (Article 10(7) of the Teacher's Charter) justifying the conclusion of fixed-term contracts with the claimant;
strings.jeśli taka potrzeba istniała — zarzut dy: if such a need existed — the charge of discrimination consisting in the conclusion of fixed-term contracts becomes moot, but the charge of discrimination connected with hiring another person for that post remains to be considered;
strings.samo stwierdzenie działania pracodawcy o: the mere finding of discriminatory conduct by the employer justifies a claim for compensation under Article 18<sup>3d</sup> of the Labour Code, whose precondition is unlawfulness itself (breach of the principle of equal treatment) — without any need to prove the employer's fault.
strings.Innymi słowy: SN nie przesądził, że powó: In other words: the Supreme Court did not decide that the claimant had been discriminated against. It did, however, decide that the courts' reasoning was flawed — a temporary residence permit cannot on its own justify either fixed-term contracts or worse treatment of a foreigner.
strings.4. Co z tego wynika dla cudzoziemców — o: 4. What this means for foreigners — risk assessment
strings.Praktyczny wniosek dla osób spoza UE leg: The practical conclusion for non-EU citizens working legally in Poland is important: the temporary nature of a residence card does not condemn a worker to endless fixed-term contracts. If an employer — without a genuine need arising from the organisation of work — concludes successive fixed-term contracts with a foreigner, it may turn out that the parties are in fact bound by an indefinite-term contract, and that differentiation based on citizenship constitutes discrimination.
strings.Trzeba jednak zachować realizm w ocenie: One must, however, remain realistic in assessing litigation risk. First, the outcome of a given case depends on the findings of fact — here the Supreme Court ordered examination of whether an organisational need existed; if so, part of the charges falls away. Second, the ruling was made in the context of the Teacher's Charter and the situation of a foreign-language teacher — transposing its theses to other sectors requires caution and an individual analysis. Third, employee claims are limited by time limits (including the limitation of claims under the employment relationship), so delay may close off the path to pursuing one's rights.
strings.<strong>Zastrzeżenie co do stanu prawneg: Reservation as to the state of the law. The judgment was handed down in 2016 under the then-applicable provisions (the Act of 20 April 2004 on employment promotion and labour market institutions and the Act of 13 June 2003 on foreigners — both later amended or replaced). The provisions on employing foreigners and on legalising residence have changed significantly — the current basis should be verified each time in the applicable text of the acts. The general theses on the prohibition of discrimination on grounds of citizenship and on freedom to choose the type of contract nevertheless retain their relevance.
strings.Jeśli jako cudzoziemiec masz wątpliwości: If, as a foreigner, you have doubts about whether your successive fixed-term contracts comply with the law, or whether you are being treated worse on grounds of citizenship — it is worth analysing the matter individually before the time limits for pursuing claims expire.

strings.Pracujesz w Polsce, a masz dochody lub r: You work in Poland but have income or residence abroad? We explain how double taxation treaties protect you from paying tax twice — and what role the certificate of residence plays.
strings.Gdy dochód może być opodatkowany w dwóch: When income may be taxed in two countries (e.g. in the country of work and in the country of residence), a risk of double taxation arises. It is resolved by double taxation treaties (DTTs), usually based on the OECD Model Convention.

strings.Którą metodę stosuje się w danym przypad: Which method applies in a given case follows from the particular DTT. Under the proportional deduction method, the abolition relief (Article 27g of the PIT Act) may be available, within the statutory limit.
strings.Aby zastosować UPO (np. niższą stawkę u: To apply a DTT (e.g. a lower withholding rate), a certificate of residence is usually required — an official confirmation of the place of residence issued by the administration of the other country.
strings.<strong>Ważne:</strong> każda UPO jest i: Important: every DTT is different. Methods, definitions and limits vary between treaties — check the wording of the treaty with the relevant country before filing.
strings.Między Polską a Ukrainą obowiązuje odręb: A separate double taxation treaty is in force between Poland and Ukraine. For income of Ukrainian citizens working in Poland it is worth establishing residence and applying the method that follows from that treaty.
