strings.Karta SIM, zameldowanie, numer PESEL, ko: SIM card, address registration, PESEL number, bank account and health insurance — where to start so that everything is legal and convenient.
strings.<span class=\"pill\">📱 SIM</span><span c: 📱 SIM🏠 Registration🔢 PESEL🏦 Bank account🏥 NFZ/ZUS
strings.Pierwsze kroki po przyjeździe — plan: First steps after arrival — the plan
strings.Kilka spraw załatwionych na starcie oszc: A few matters settled at the start will save you time and stress later. Here is the typical order for someone arriving for work.
strings.Polski numer przyda się do banku, aplika: A Polish number will be useful for the bank, apps and contact with your employer. Registering the card in your name (with a document) is required by law.
strings.Zameldowanie pod adresem pobytu — dzięki: Registering at your address of stay — it makes obtaining a PESEL easier. You report it at the commune/city office.
strings.11-cyfrowy numer identyfikacyjny — potrz: An 11-digit identification number — needed among other things for a contract, a bank account and tax settlements.
strings.Na wypłatę i płatności. Zwykle wystarczy: For your salary and payments. A passport is usually enough; a PESEL and a Polish phone number speed up opening it.
strings.Jeżeli mieszkasz w Polsce dłużej niż 30: If you live in Poland for longer than 30 days, you can register your address — a PESEL is then assigned automatically. If you have no registered address, a PESEL can also be obtained on request, where the law requires you to have one (e.g. for tax, insurance or bank account purposes). The application is filed at the commune/city office.
strings.<b>Po co PESEL:</b> ułatwia zawarcie umo: What a PESEL is for: it makes it easier to conclude an employment/mandate contract, open a bank account, settle tax (PIT) and use e-services. You will find the official description of the service on gov.pl (link in the sources).
strings.Bez lokalnego numeru trudno funkcjonować: Without a local number it is hard to function — you need it for SMS codes from the bank, transport apps and contact with your employer. You can buy a prepaid card at an operator's shop, a kiosk or a supermarket, but it must be registered with your personal data (with an identity document) — this is a legal requirement; an unregistered card will be blocked.
strings.Gdy pracujesz legalnie na umowie, pracod: When you work legally under a contract, your employer registers you with ZUS and you use public healthcare financed by the NFZ. It is worth confirming with your employer that the insurance registration has been made — this is your right and the basis for treatment.
strings.Nie masz pewności, czy wszystko jest leg: Not sure whether everything is legal?
strings.Sprawdzimy Twoją umowę, zgłoszenie do ZU: We will check your contract, your ZUS registration and your residence title — and help with your residence and work application.
strings.<a class=\"btn btn-gold\" href=\"formula: I need legal help →Benefits and allowances
strings.Czy mogę założyć konto bez PESEL i meldu: Can I open a bank account without a PESEL and address registration?
strings.W wielu bankach tak — zwłaszcza dla obyw: In many banks yes — especially for Ukrainian citizens a passport and confirmation of legal stay are enough. A PESEL and a Polish phone number do, however, speed up identification and activation of banking services.
strings.Zameldowanie to formalność, która ułatwi: Address registration is a formality that makes obtaining a PESEL and other matters easier. For a bank account, registration is usually not required — the actual address of residence is enough.
strings.Kto zgłasza mnie do ubezpieczenia zdrowo: Who registers me for health insurance?
strings.Przy legalnym zatrudnieniu robi to praco: In legal employment this is done by the employer (registration with ZUS). It is worth asking for confirmation that the registration has been made.

strings.Zanim ruszysz do pracy, kilka formalnośc: Before you start work, a few formalities will make your life easier: a PESEL number, address registration, a bank account, a Polish SIM card and health insurance. We describe the order and details separately.

strings.<b>Złota zasada:</b> za samo znalezienie: The golden rule: you do not pay an intermediary merely for finding you a job in Poland. If someone demands a fee "for arranging work" or offers wages "off the books" without a contract — that is a warning sign.
strings.Sprawdź agencję pracy w oficjalnym <b>Kr: Check the employment agency in the official National Register of Employment Agencies (KRAZ) — a legal agency must be entered there. Always demand a written contract in a language you understand, and never hand your passport over to anyone "for safekeeping". Beware of housing offers where you pay in advance before seeing the property.

strings.To nie obywatelstwo decyduje o prawie do: It is not citizenship that decides your right to a benefit, but a combination of four elements. The same foreigner may be entitled to one benefit and not to another.
strings.Rodzaj i podstawa Twojego legalnego poby: The type and basis of your legal stay (stamp after filing the application, residence card, permanent residence). The "stronger" it is, the broader your access to benefits.
strings.Zezwolenie na pracę, oświadczenie albo p: A work permit, a declaration, or temporary residence and work — plus the annotation "access to the labour market", which is crucial for 800+.
strings.Czy i do jakich ubezpieczeń jesteś zgłos: Whether and to which insurance you are registered — especially sickness insurance. Your allowances depend on it: sickness, maternity, care.
strings.Część świadczeń rodzinnych i pomoc społe: Some family benefits and social assistance depend on income per person in the family. ZUS allowances — do not.
strings.<b>W skrócie:</b> najpewniejsze są świad: In short: the most reliable are ZUS benefits (they depend on contributions, not on citizenship). Family benefits and social assistance more often require a "stronger" residence title than just the stamp after filing the application.

strings.Świadczenia z ubezpieczenia społecznego: Social insurance benefits depend on being covered by insurance (especially sickness insurance), not on citizenship. If you work legally and are registered with ZUS, you have the same access to them as a Polish citizen.
strings.Po tzw. okresie wyczekiwania: <b>30 dni<: After the so-called qualifying period: 30 days for compulsory insurance (employment contract) or 90 days for voluntary insurance (mandate contract).
strings.Na opiekę nad chorym dzieckiem lub innym: For caring for a sick child or another family member. No qualifying period — from the first day of sickness insurance.

strings.Świadczenie wychowawcze <b>800+</b> przy: The 800+ child-raising benefit is available, among others, to foreigners who hold a residence card with the annotation "access to the labour market", if they live in Poland together with their children — as well as to people with permanent residence, refugee status, subsidiary or humanitarian protection. Excluded are, among others, foreigners with the right to work for up to 6 months, those staying for studies or on the basis of a visa alone.

The right to the benefit arises after proving at least 365 days of work with Labour Fund contributions paid within the 18 months before registration.

strings.1. Pobyt czasowy w Polsce — jak uporządk: 1. Temporary residence in Poland — how to put your legal stay in order
strings.Zezwolenie na pobyt czasowy to podstawow: A temporary residence permit is the basic way of legalising a foreigner's stay in Poland — granted for up to 3 years and confirmed with a residence card. The most common problems are: filing too late, choosing the wrong basis of stay and incomplete residence card documents.
strings.Kiedy złożyć wniosek o pobyt czasowy?: When to file a temporary residence application?
strings.Wniosek trzeba złożyć najpóźniej ostatni: The application must be filed no later than the last day of your legal stay (visa, visa-free travel or your current card). Filing on time and without formal gaps gives you legal stay for the whole proceedings. From 27 April 2026 applications are filed exclusively electronically in the MOS system — paper applications are left without examination.
strings.Pierwszy wniosek czy kolejny — czym się: First application or the next one — what is the difference?
strings.Karty pobytu czasowego nie przedłuża się: A temporary residence card is not extended — before it expires you file a new, complete application. With the next application the office re-examines your whole situation: work, income, insurance, place of residence. We help you file the first application, the next one and put your legal stay in order when there have been gaps.
strings.<strong>Jak pomagamy:</strong> dobieramy: How we help: we choose the right basis of stay, complete the documents, file the application in MOS and watch over the case until you collect the residence card. Details: Temporary residence card — everything you need to know.
strings.2. Legalna praca i pobyt — jakie dokumen: 2. Legal work and residence — which documents you need
strings.Legalna praca cudzoziemca w Polsce wymag: Legal work of a foreigner in Poland requires two things at once: legal residence and a document entitling you to work. We check whether you can work legally and which documents you need in your situation.
strings.Jakie dokumenty pozwalają pracować legal: Which documents allow you to work legally in Poland?
strings.<strong>Zezwolenie jednolite</strong> (p: Single permit (temporary residence and work) — one voivode decision combining residence and work for a specific employer.
strings.<strong>Zezwolenie na pracę</strong> — u: Work permit — obtained by the employer, requires a separate residence title (e.g. a visa).
strings.<strong>Oświadczenie o powierzeniu wykon: Declaration on entrusting work — a faster path for citizens of selected countries.
strings.Czy mogę pracować, czekając na kartę pob: Can I work while waiting for my residence card?
strings.To zależy od Twojej sytuacji: znaczenie: It depends on your situation: what matters is, among other things, whether your previous document allowed work for this employer and whether the application was filed on time. Work without the required document is illegal employment — a risk of penalties and problems with the next legalisation. Before you start work, check your situation — we will assess your documents free of charge.
strings.<strong>Jak pomagamy:</strong> analizuje: How we help: we analyse your documents and your employer's documents, choose the fastest legal path and run the case to a decision.

strings.3. Brak decyzji i długi czas oczekiwania: 3. No decision and long waiting time for a residence card — what to do
strings.Długi czas oczekiwania na kartę pobytu t: Long waiting time for a residence card is one of the most common problems of foreigners in Poland. Months without a reply, no letter from the office, a helpline that doesn't work — but the office's inaction is not a dead end.
strings.Co zrobić, gdy urząd nie wydaje decyzji?: What to do when the office does not issue a decision?
strings.<strong>Ponaglenie</strong> — pismo do o: Reminder (ponaglenie) — a letter to the higher authority when the case takes longer than the law provides. The office must respond to it.
strings.<strong>Skarga na bezczynność lub przewl: Complaint about inaction or excessive length to the voivodeship administrative court — when the reminder doesn't work; the court can order the office to issue a decision.
strings.Brak wezwania nie zawsze oznacza, że spr: No letter does not always mean the case is going well — it may have gone to a wrong address or to a representative you don't control (e.g. appointed by an agency). We check the case files, establish what stage the proceedings are at and take over correspondence with the office. More: No letter from the office — what to do.
strings.<strong>Jak pomagamy:</strong> piszemy p: How we help: we write the reminder, prepare the complaint about inaction and act when the case takes too long and the office does nothing.
strings.4. Błędy i braki formalne we wniosku o k: 4. Errors and formal gaps in the residence card application — how to fix them
strings.Braki formalne wniosku to najczęstszy po: Formal gaps in the application are the most common reason a residence card case ends before it began. No signature, no photos, unpaid stamp duty, missing attachments — the office calls for completion, and if you don't make it, it leaves the application without examination.
strings.Co oznacza pozostawienie wniosku bez roz: What does leaving the application without examination mean?
strings.Urząd traktuje sprawę tak, jakby wniosek: The office treats the case as if the application had never arrived. You lose the legal stay resulting from filing — and often also the deadline in which you could have filed. That is why you must reply to the call to complete the gaps within the set deadline, completely and with proof of submission.
strings.Jakie błędy we wniosku zdarzają się najc: Which application errors happen most often?
strings.zła podstawa pobytu lub niewłaściwy typ: wrong basis of stay or wrong type of application,
strings.rozbieżności między wnioskiem a dokument: discrepancies between the application and the employer's documents,
strings.brakujące załączniki: ubezpieczenie, doc: missing attachments: insurance, income, place of residence,
strings.błędy techniczne w systemie MOS — zobacz: technical errors in the MOS system — see: MOS: errors and formal gaps.
strings.<strong>Jak pomagamy:</strong> uzupełnia: How we help: we complete the documents, correct the application and prepare the case for filing — and when the call has already arrived, we reply to it on time.
strings.5. Zmiana pracodawcy lub warunków pracy: 5. Change of employer or working conditions — what to report so you do not lose your residence card
strings.Karta pobytu a zmiana pracodawcy to tema: A residence card and a change of employer is the topic where foreigners lose the legality of their stay most often. The single permit names a specific employer and working conditions — a new job, a different position or reduced hours usually require a reaction.
strings.Straciłem pracę — ile mam czasu?: I lost my job — how much time do I have?
strings.Utratę pracy trzeba zgłosić wojewodzie p: You must report the loss of your job to the voivode in writing within 15 working days. Reporting on time protects you from withdrawal of the permit and gives you time to find a new employer and file a new application.
strings.Zmieniam pracodawcę — co dalej?: I am changing employer — what next?
strings.Co do zasady potrzebna jest zmiana zezwo: As a rule you need a change of the permit or a new application — a new contract alone is not enough. We explain what must be reported and how not to lose the legality of your stay and work: Change of employer and the residence card.
strings.Kto powinien prowadzić sprawę o kartę po: Who should handle your residence card case — your employer or a lawyer?
strings.Jeśli kartę robił za Ciebie pracodawca l: If your card was handled by your employer or an agency, the case may be run in their interest, not yours — and when you change jobs you lose control of your own stay. Check your rights: Residence card — lawyer or employer?
strings.<strong>Jak pomagamy:</strong> zgłaszamy: How we help: we report the loss of work on time, prepare a new application or a change of the permit and take the case over from the employer or agency.

strings.6. Odmowa, cofnięcie zezwolenia, pobyt n: 6. Refusal, withdrawal of the permit, illegal stay — appeal against the decision
strings.Odmowa wydania karty pobytu, cofnięcie z: Refusal of a residence card, withdrawal of a permit or a stay that has become illegal — these are the hardest, yet still solvable, legalisation problems. Many negative decisions are issued for formal reasons that can be challenged.
strings.Dostałem decyzję odmowną — ile mam czasu: I received a negative decision — how much time do I have to appeal?
strings.Odwołanie od decyzji wojewody składa się: The appeal against the voivode's decision is filed within 14 days of its delivery — to the Head of the Office for Foreigners, via the voivode. After this deadline the decision becomes final, so every day counts.
strings.Mój pobyt jest nielegalny — czy da się t: My stay is illegal — can it be fixed?
strings.W wielu sytuacjach tak — możliwości zale: In many situations yes — the options depend on how the legal stay was lost and how long it has lasted. We analyse the case and look for a further legal solution; the sooner you react, the more options remain open. On withdrawal and expiry of permits: Withdrawal, revocation and expiry of a permit.
strings.<strong>Jak pomagamy:</strong> analizuje: How we help: we analyse the files, find the office's errors, prepare appeals and — when needed — a complaint to the administrative court.

strings.7 sierpnia 2026 r. w Dzienniku Ustaw uka: On 7 August 2026 a regulation was published in the Journal of Laws that closes one of the most frequently used employment "loopholes": citizens of Venezuela, Georgia and Colombia will no longer be able to work in Poland on the basis of a work permit if they are staying here solely under visa-free travel. Below we explain exactly what is changing, who is affected, how the Polish labour market looks against this backdrop and which legal employment paths remain.

strings.Chodzi o <strong>rozporządzenie Ministra: This concerns the Regulation of the Minister of Family, Labour and Social Policy of 31 July 2026 on the list of states whose citizens holding a work permit are not entitled to perform work while staying on the territory of the Republic of Poland under visa-free travel (Journal of Laws 2026, item 1072). The act was issued on the basis of Article 3(4) of the Act of 20 March 2025 on the conditions of admissibility of entrusting work to foreigners on the territory of the Republic of Poland (Journal of Laws 2025, item 621).
strings.Treść jest krótka i mieści się w trzech: The text is short and fits into three sections:
strings.<strong>§ 1</strong> — obywatele Boliwar: § 1 — citizens of the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela, Georgia and the Republic of Colombia are not entitled to perform work on the basis of a work permit while staying under visa-free travel;
strings.<strong>§ 2</strong> — przepis przejścio: § 2 — transitional provision: persons from these states who started work under visa-free travel before the regulation entered into force may continue it under the existing rules until the end of the permitted visa-free stay;
strings.<strong>§ 3</strong> — rozporządzenie wc: § 3 — the regulation enters into force 14 days after the date of its publication.
strings.<strong>Kiedy zacznie obowiązywać?</stro: When will it take effect? Publication took place on 7 August 2026, and the regulation enters into force 14 days after that date — that is, in the second half of August 2026. Press reports point to 21 August 2026. The exact day is worth confirming in the text of Journal of Laws 2026, item 1072.
strings.2. Kogo i czego dotyczy zakaz — a czego: 2. Whom and what the ban covers — and what it does not
strings.To ograniczenie <strong>nie jest zakazem: This restriction is not a ban on entry or stay. Citizens of Venezuela, Georgia and Colombia may still come to Poland under visa-free travel (a stay of up to 90 days in any 180-day period), provided the EU rules on visa exemption do not change. One thing changes, but a key one: visa-free stay alone ceases to be a title that allows one to work legally on a work permit.
strings.Zakaz <strong>nie obejmuje</strong> prac: The ban does not cover work performed on another, "stronger" residence basis, in particular:
strings.na <strong>wizie krajowej typu D</strong: on a national type-D visa (e.g. a visa for the purpose of performing work),
strings.na podstawie <strong>zezwolenia na pobyt: on the basis of a temporary residence permit and the residence card issued on its basis (including the single permit — for temporary residence and work).
strings.Logika przepisu jest więc taka: ruch bez: The logic of the provision is therefore this: visa-free travel is meant to serve short stays (tourism, family visits, business), not earning a living; a foreigner's work should be tied to a more formalised residence title.
strings.<strong>Uwaga na model „bezwiza + praca: Beware of the "visa-free + work + residence card" model. Until now a common practice was: entry under visa-free travel, taking up work on a permit/declaration and, in parallel, filing an application for temporary residence. Once the regulation enters into force, this scheme stops working for the three indicated states at the "work under visa-free travel" stage. Employment must be based on a visa or a residence card.
strings.3. Polski rynek pracy: ilu jest cudzozie: 3. The Polish labour market: how many foreigners there are and how many workers are missing
strings.Zmiana zapada w momencie, gdy rynek prac: The change comes at a time when the labour market is still tight and the economy strongly benefits from foreign labour. The key figures (data from the Social Insurance Institution (ZUS) and Statistics Poland (GUS) at the turn of 2025/2026 and in the first half of 2026):
strings.do ZUS zgłoszonych jest <strong>ponad 1,: over 1.3 million foreigners are registered with ZUS — about 8% of all insured persons; over the year their number rose by about 95,000;
strings.największe grupy to obywatele <strong>Uk: the largest groups are citizens of Ukraine (about 857,000) and Belarus (about 139,000); Georgians number about 26,000 insured persons — the third-largest group;
strings.<strong>bezrobocie rejestrowane</strong>: registered unemployment in July 2026 stood at about 5.9% (about 907,000 people on the registers), and under the Eurostat definition Poland has one of the lowest unemployment rates in the EU (about 3.1%);
strings.na koniec I kwartału 2026 r. w Polsce by: at the end of the first quarter of 2026 there were about 100,000 job vacancies in Poland; the most vacancies concern specialists, machine operators and assemblers, and service workers.
strings.Cudzoziemcy — w tym dotąd obywatele Kolu: Foreigners — including, until now, citizens of Colombia, Venezuela and Georgia — filled the gap especially in construction, transport, logistics, agriculture, services and simple manufacturing. These are jobs that some domestic workers do not take up because of the conditions, prestige or pay, and not because there are physically "no" willing candidates.
strings.4. Dlaczego akurat te trzy kraje — gospo: 4. Why these three countries in particular — economy, security, politics
strings.Selektywny dobór państw sprawia, że rozp: The selective choice of states means the regulation is hard to explain by the labour-market situation alone. In public debate at least three ways of reading this decision clash; we present them as the positions of the parties, not as our own assessment.
strings.Argument bezpieczeństwa i porządku (stro: The security and public-order argument (the government's side)
strings.Resort pracy i MSZ wskazują, że ruch bez: The Ministry of Labour and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs point out that visa-free travel was systemically misused — for earning a living while bypassing the requirements, which fostered illegal stay and illegal entrustment of work. Data on the scale of the phenomenon is cited: the number of work-legalising documents issued to Colombian citizens rose from about 12,300 (2023) to about 40,400 (2024), and inspections revealed a high proportion of illegal work; in the case of Georgia, the theme of crime and human smuggling is raised. This fits into the migration strategy announced in October 2024 and the general tightening of policy (fewer visas, fewer new permits, more returns).
strings.Organizacje pracodawców zwracają uwagę,: Employers' organisations point out that, with sustained demand for workers and a high number of vacancies, cutting off yet another channel of inflowing labour may curb growth and deepen shortages in sectors dependent on migrants. On this view the regulation is sometimes assessed as "short-sighted" in relation to the needs of the economy.
strings.W komentarzach pojawia się też teza, że: Commentators also advance the thesis that such tough signals in migration policy serve as a political message aimed at part of the electorate afraid of competition in the labour market and of the growing presence of foreigners. This should be treated as an interpretation present in the debate, not a provable fact: the regulation itself refers to public-order and security grounds, not to the electoral calendar. A sound assessment requires separating three orders — the legal (what the provision says), the economic (what effect it has on the market) and the political (how the decision is communicated).
strings.<strong>Nasza ostrożna konkluzja.</stron: Our cautious conclusion. From the standpoint of pure economics, the restriction looks at odds with current demand for workers. From the standpoint of migration policy, it is consistent with a course towards tightening and control. Which motives prevailed remains a matter of judgement — the available sources do not allow this to be settled with certainty.
strings.5. Co robić: legalne ścieżki pracy i oce: 5. What to do: legal work paths and risk assessment
strings.Dla pracodawców i cudzoziemców z trzech: For employers and foreigners from the three affected states, the key is to switch from the "visa-free + work" model to a residence title that permits work. Possible solutions:
strings.<strong>Wiza krajowa typu D w celu pracy: A national type-D visa for work. Obtained before arrival or in another configuration, it allows work on a work permit without any link to visa-free travel. It does, however, require a consular procedure and time.
strings.<strong>Zezwolenie na pobyt czasowy i pr: A temporary residence and work permit (residence card), including the single permit. Since 27 April 2026, applications for temporary residence are filed electronically via the MOS portal (mos.cudzoziemcy.gov.pl). An application filed no later than on the last day of legal stay, free of formal defects, secures the legality of stay until the case is resolved (Article 105 and Article 108 of the Act on Foreigners).
strings.<strong>Uporządkowanie osób już pracując: Regularising those already working. Anyone who started work under visa-free travel before the regulation entered into force benefits from the transitional provision (§ 2) — but only until the end of the current visa-free stay. This is real, though short, time to move to a visa or a residence card.
strings.<strong>Ocena ryzyka.</strong> Praca na: Risk assessment. Work on a permit under visa-free travel after the rules take effect will constitute illegal entrustment of work — with the risk of sanctions for the employer (a fine) and residence-related consequences for the foreigner (up to and including a return decision and an entry ban). The greatest risk concerns schemes based solely on visa-free travel and situations in which the transitional period under § 2 expires while a new residence title has not yet been obtained. We recommend planning the path in advance (a type-D visa or MOS) and an individual legal consultation — each person's factual situation may differ.

strings.Niepotrzebne wezwanie ratowników na plaż: An unnecessary call-out of rescuers on the beach: how the maritime rescue service works and what you risk for a false alarm
strings.Data publikacji: 11 sierpnia 2026 · Auto: Published: 11 August 2026 · Author: Dariusz Włodarczyk Kancelaria TRC · Reading time: approx. 7 min
strings.Sezon wakacyjny nad Bałtykiem to setki i: The holiday season on the Baltic means hundreds of rescuer interventions. Some of them turn out to be unnecessary — like the incident of 9 August 2026 in Ustka, where maritime rescue, WOPR, the ambulance service and a helicopter were mobilised for an allegedly drowning woman, while the person was in fact intoxicated and not in the water. Below we explain — without judging anyone's nationality — how the maritime search and rescue service actually works, when to really call for help, and what legal liability you risk for knowingly misleading the services. The material is educational in nature and is particularly important for foreigners, who do not always know Polish procedures and regulations.
strings.<a href=\"#sek1\">Co się wydarzyło w Ust: What happened in Ustka — the facts
strings.<a href=\"#sek2\">Jak działa morska służ: How the maritime search and rescue service works
strings.<a href=\"#sek3\">Odpowiedzialność prawn: Legal liability for a false alarm (art. 66 of the Code of Petty Offences)
strings.<a href=\"#sek4\">Jak reagować prawidłow: How to react correctly — and what it means for a foreigner
strings.1. Co się wydarzyło w Ustce — fakty: 1. What happened in Ustka — the facts
strings.Według relacji TVP 3 Gdańsk, powielonej: According to a report by TVP 3 Gdańsk, reproduced among others by the o2.pl portal, on Sunday 9 August 2026 at around 7.00 p.m. the services received a call to the beach in Ustka. The report concerned a woman who was allegedly drowning at an unguarded bathing area and was "pulled unconscious from the water" by the people accompanying her. Rescuers of the maritime rescue service (SAR), WOPR, a Medical Rescue Team were involved in the operation, and a helicopter of the Air Ambulance Service landed on the beach.
strings.Na miejscu okazało się, że kobieta była: On the spot it turned out that the woman was completely dry and had no symptoms typical of a person who had nearly drowned — according to the reports she was heavily intoxicated. The media reported unofficially that she may have had over 2.5 per mille of alcohol. Her companions, not knowing how to get her off the beach, called the emergency services. We stress: these are journalistic findings, and the legal assessment of the incident rests with the police and the court — we do not prejudge anyone's guilt.
strings.Nagranie z interwencji · źródło: Faceboo: Recording of the intervention · source: Facebook / Morska Służba Poszukiwania i Ratownictwa
strings.<strong>Dlaczego to nie jest błahostka.<: Why this is not a trivial matter. Every such operation involves real forces and resources — the crew of a rescue vessel, a helicopter, an ambulance. During that time rescuers may fail to reach in time somewhere where someone is really drowning. An unnecessary call-out is not a "trifle" but taking help away from someone else.
strings.2. Jak działa morska służba poszukiwania: 2. How the maritime search and rescue service works
strings.Morska Służba Poszukiwania i Ratownictwa: The Maritime Search and Rescue Service (SAR) is a state organisational unit operating under the Act of 18 August 2011 on maritime safety. Its task is to search for and save life in Polish maritime areas — regardless of the nationality of the person rescued and without charging the victim. Operations are coordinated by the Maritime Rescue Coordination Centre in Gdynia, and on the water WOPR rescuers, Medical Rescue Teams and, if necessary, the Air Ambulance Service cooperate with SAR.
strings.W praktyce dla osoby na plaży istotne są: In practice, three numbers matter for a person on the beach: 112 — the general emergency number, from which the dispatcher will redirect the call to the appropriate service; 601 100 100 — the water emergency number (WOPR); and 984 — the Volunteer Water Rescue Service on some bodies of water. If you are not sure which to choose, call 112 — it is always a safe choice, also when you do not speak Polish well (dispatchers also handle English).
strings.<strong>Ratunek jest darmowy i dla każde: Rescue is free and for everyone. Calling for help when life is genuinely in danger is never a "problem" — even if the alarm turns out to be false by mistake. The law punishes the deliberate, malicious misleading of the services, not a justified fear for someone's life.
strings.3. Odpowiedzialność prawna za fałszywy a: 3. Legal liability for a false alarm (art. 66 of the Code of Petty Offences)
The basic provision is art. 66 of the Code of Petty Offences (Act of 20 May 1971). Under § 1: whoever, wishing to cause an unnecessary action, misleads a public utility institution or another body protecting safety, public order or health with a false alarm, information or in another way — is liable to arrest, restriction of liberty or a fine of up to PLN 1,500. Under § 2, if the petty offence caused an unnecessary action, an additional supplementary payment of up to PLN 1,000 may be ordered.
strings.<strong>Kluczowa przesłanka: zamiar.</st: The key element: intent. Art. 66 of the Code of Petty Offences requires action aimed at causing an unnecessary action (an element of malice or wantonness). If the person calling for help was mistaken and genuinely feared for a friend's life, classification as a petty offence may be doubtful. Conversely — a deliberate report of a drowning that never took place falls within the scope of art. 66. Each case must be assessed individually; the final assessment rests with the law-enforcement authorities and the court.
strings.Warto rozważyć kilka możliwych scenarius: It is worth considering several possible scenarios of liability:
strings.<strong>Brak odpowiedzialności wykroczen: No petty-offence liability — where the person reporting acted in a justified conviction that life was in danger (panic, an intoxicated, unconscious person). Calling for help is then desirable conduct.
strings.<strong>Wykroczenie z art. 66 KW</strong: Petty offence under art. 66 of the Code of Petty Offences — where the person reporting knowingly gave false information (e.g. that someone is drowning) in order to trigger an intervention. Sanction: arrest, restriction of liberty or a fine of up to PLN 1,500, possibly a supplementary payment of up to PLN 1,000.
strings.<strong>Roszczenie o zwrot kosztów</stro: Claim for reimbursement of costs — in some situations, the entity that bore the costs of an unnecessary operation may pursue their compensation under the general principles of civil law. This is not automatic, however, and depends on the circumstances; this thread requires a separate analysis in the specific case.
strings.Odrębną kwestią jest odpowiedzialność za: A separate issue is liability for the mere consumption of alcohol in a public place (art. 43(1) of the Act on upbringing in sobriety) or possible disturbance of order — these, however, are grounds other than a false alarm and should not be confused.
strings.4. Jak reagować prawidłowo — i co to zna: 4. How to react correctly — and what it means for a foreigner
strings.Gdy ktoś jest nietrzeźwy, senny lub niep: When someone is intoxicated, drowsy or unconscious on the beach but is not in the water, it is usually not a matter for maritime rescue. Place the person in the recovery position, provide shade and water, do not leave them alone. If they are unconscious, having convulsions, not breathing properly or there is a genuine suspicion that they were in the water — call 112 and calmly describe the real situation. Giving true information allows the dispatcher to send the right help and does not expose anyone to liability.
strings.<strong>Dlaczego to szczególnie istotne: Why this is particularly important for foreigners. A final penalty for a petty offence does not in itself usually mean the loss of the right of residence, but gross or repeated breaches of public order may be taken into account in residence and return proceedings conducted by the authorities (cf. the Act of 12 December 2013 on foreigners). That is why it is worth knowing the rules and avoiding situations that could affect legal residence. When in contact with the services, you have the right to an interpreter.
strings.Podsumowując ocenę ryzyka: dzwoniąc po p: To sum up the risk assessment: by calling for help in good faith, you risk no penalty — even in case of a mistake. The risk arises only when you knowingly mislead the services. If you have received a fine or a summons in connection with such an intervention and do not know how to react (accept the fine, refuse, submit explanations), consult the matter with a lawyer before making a decision — it also matters for your residence situation.
strings.Dostałeś mandat lub wezwanie i nie wiesz: Have you received a fine or a summons and don't know what to do?
strings.Sprawdzimy, czy zarzut jest zasadny, pom: We will check whether the charge is justified, help prepare explanations or a refusal to accept the fine, and assess the impact of the case on your legal residence in Poland.

strings.Kontrola PIP bez zapowiedzi — prawa i ob: Unannounced PIP inspection — employer’s rights and obligations in 2026
strings.Data publikacji: 13 sierpnia 2026 · Auto: Published: 13 August 2026 · Author: Dariusz Włodarczyk Kancelaria TRC · Reading time: approx. 9 min
strings.Inspektor Państwowej Inspekcji Pracy moż: A State Labour Inspectorate (PIP) inspector may turn up at a company from one day to the next — without prior notice and at any time. For an employer this means one thing: readiness for an inspection must be permanent, not built only when the inspector is already at the door. Below we explain the legal basis for an unannounced inspection, what changed as of 8 July 2026, and how an inspection proceeds step by step — from the inspector’s entry, through the report, to legal remedies, appeals and penalties. Separately we discuss the most common flashpoint in companies employing foreigners: the legality of employing foreigners and residence documents, including the residence card.
strings.<a href=\"#sek3\">Uprawnienia inspektora: The inspector’s powers during the inspection
strings.<a href=\"#sek4\">Legalność zatrudnienia: Legality of employing foreigners — what the inspector checks
strings.<a href=\"#sek5\">Czy można odmówić wstę: Can entry be refused to the inspector
strings.<a href=\"#sek6\">Jak przygotować firmę: How to prepare the company for an unannounced inspection
strings.<a href=\"#sek8\">Po kontroli — środki p: After the inspection — legal remedies and appeals
strings.Prawo do kontroli bez uprzedzenia wynika: The right to inspect without notice follows directly from the Act on the State Labour Inspectorate. Under art. 24(1) of that Act, a labour inspector is entitled to carry out inspections of compliance with labour law — in particular the state of occupational health and safety, the rules on legality of employment and payment of remuneration at least at the minimum hourly rate — without notice and at any time of day or night. In practice an inspection takes place during the establishment’s working hours, but it may also cover shift work and night-time.
strings.Kontrolę podejmuje się po okazaniu legit: The inspection is undertaken after presentation of an official ID confirming the inspector’s identity and powers (art. 24(2)). At an entrepreneur’s premises the inspector acts on the basis of a named authorisation; however, the Act allows the inspection to be undertaken already after presentation of the ID alone, with the authorisation served at a later date — which is why the lack of an authorisation “at the door” is not in itself grounds for refusing the inspector entry.
strings.Od 8 lipca 2026 r. obowiązuje nowelizacj: Since 8 July 2026 an amendment to the PIP Act has been in force (the Act of 11 March 2026 amending the Act on the State Labour Inspectorate and certain other acts, Journal of Laws 2026 item 473). It is the broadest change to the inspectorate’s powers in years. The key points:
strings.<strong>Szerszy krąg kontrolowanych.</st: A wider circle of those inspected. The amended art. 13 of the PIP Act extends inspection — in the field of OHS, legality of employment and the conclusion of civil-law contracts in conditions where, under art. 22 § 1 of the Labour Code, an employment contract should have been concluded — also to entrepreneurs who are not employers and other entities for which work was performed (including under the B2B model) in the year preceding the start of the inspection. Terminating contracts just before an inspection no longer protects against it being carried out.
strings.<strong>Decyzja o ustaleniu istnienia st: Decision establishing the existence of an employment relationship. The inspector may issue a decision reclassifying a civil-law contract (or B2B) into an employment contract where the work is performed in the conditions of art. 22 § 1 of the Labour Code. The decision produces effects under labour, tax and social-insurance law.
strings.<strong>Kontrola zdalna i elektroniczne: Remote inspection and electronic reports. Inspection activities may also be carried out via a postal operator or means of electronic communication, if this is not contrary to the purpose of the inspection and the nature of the activity; the report may be drawn up in electronic form.
strings.<strong>Wyższe kary.</strong> Podniesion: Higher penalties. The upper limits of fines for offences against employee rights have been raised (more in section 9).
strings.3. Uprawnienia inspektora w trakcie kont: 3. The inspector’s powers during the inspection
strings.Zakres uprawnień inspektora jest szeroki: The scope of the inspector’s powers is broad and covers both documents and activities on the establishment’s premises. In practice the inspector may, among other things:
strings.wejść na teren oraz do obiektów i pomies: enter the premises and the buildings and rooms of the inspected entity,
strings.żądać okazania dokumentów dotyczących za: demand the production of documents concerning employment, wages, working time, OHS and legality of employment (including of foreigners),
strings.przesłuchiwać i odbierać wyjaśnienia — t: question and take explanations — also from employees and persons actually performing the work,
strings.sporządzać kopie, odpisy i zestawienia o: make copies, extracts and summaries and secure evidence,
strings.po kontroli stosować środki prawne: naka: after the inspection, apply legal measures: orders, submissions, instructions and, in justified cases, refer requests for punishment or notifications to other authorities.
strings.Ustalenia kontroli mogą się przełożyć ni: The inspection’s findings may translate not only into a “report”, but also into decisions in the field of OHS (up to and including suspension of work), fines in offence cases, and material for further proceedings.
strings.4. Legalność zatrudnienia cudzoziemców —: 4. Legality of employing foreigners — what the inspector checks
strings.Legalność zatrudnienia <strong>cudzoziem: The legality of employing foreigners is one of the main areas of PIP inspection, often carried out in cooperation with the Border Guard. Since 1 June 2025, entrusting work to foreigners has been governed by the Act of 20 March 2025 on the conditions of admissibility of entrusting work to foreigners (Journal of Laws 2025 item 621). The inspector verifies two separate layers of legality — residence and work:
strings.<strong>tytuł pobytowy</strong> — ważna: the residence title — a valid residence card, national visa or another document authorising residence, or a status legalising residence while the application is being examined;
strings.<strong>podstawę do wykonywania pracy</s: the basis for performing work — a work permit, a single permit for residence and work, or a declaration on entrusting work entered in the register;
strings.zgodność faktycznych warunków pracy (sta: the conformity of the actual working conditions (position, pay, working time) with the content of the permit or declaration.
strings.5. Czy można odmówić wstępu inspektorowi: 5. Can entry be refused to the inspector
strings.Co do zasady pracodawca nie może odmówić: As a rule, an employer may not refuse the inspector entry — the right to enter and conduct an inspection follows from the PIP Act. Refusing, obstructing or thwarting an inspection gives rise to liability (section 9). What is permissible, however, are steps that order the course of the inspection, provided they are not obstructive in character:
strings.weryfikacja tożsamości inspektora (legit: verification of the inspector’s identity (official ID) — in case of doubt it can be confirmed at the district labour inspectorate,
strings.wyznaczenie osoby do kontaktu i miejsca: designating a contact person and a place for the inspector to work,
strings.przygotowanie dokumentów w rozsądnym cza: preparing documents within a reasonable time, respecting data-protection rules (GDPR), whereby this may not prevent the exercise of inspection powers.
strings.Odrębną kwestią jest zakres konkretnego: A separate matter is the scope of a specific request. If it concerns information unrelated to employment, OHS or the legality of work, one may ask for the legal basis and purpose to be indicated; the assessment of a “connection” with the inspection, however, depends on the circumstances and requires caution.
strings.6. Jak przygotować firmę na niezapowiedz: 6. How to prepare the company for an unannounced inspection
strings.Dobre przygotowanie skraca czas kontroli: Good preparation shortens the inspection and reduces the risk of accidental procedural violations. In practice four elements work well:
strings.<strong>Procedura „pierwszego kontaktu\": A “first contact” procedure — who verifies the inspector, where they direct them, who accompanies them during the inspection and who is responsible for communication.
strings.<strong>Mapa dokumentów</strong> — gdzie: A document map — where they are: working-time records, payrolls, contracts, OHS training and examinations, as well as documentation on the legality of employing foreigners (residence cards, permits/declarations, notifications).
strings.<strong>Szkolenie kadry kierowniczej</st: Training of managerial staff — how to give explanations, what not to declare “on the fly”, when to escalate to the legal department.
strings.<strong>Zasady obsługi danych</strong> —: Data-handling rules — rules for making copies and providing documents based on the purpose of the inspection.
strings.Ustalenia kontroli inspektor dokumentuje: The inspector documents the inspection’s findings in a report drawn up in writing — in paper or electronic form (art. 31 of the PIP Act). The employer’s key power is the right to objections:
strings.przed podpisaniem protokołu podmiot kont: before signing the report, the inspected entity has the right to raise reasoned objections to the findings,
strings.zastrzeżenia wnosi się na piśmie w termi: objections are submitted in writing within 7 days of the date the report is presented,
strings.inspektor ma obowiązek je zbadać, a w ra: the inspector is obliged to examine them and, if found justified, to amend or supplement the report.
strings.Termin 7 dni jest realny do wykorzystani: The 7-day deadline is realistic to make use of.
strings.8. Po kontroli — środki prawne i odwołan: 8. After the inspection — legal remedies and appeals
strings.W następstwie kontroli inspektor może za: Following the inspection the inspector may apply, among other things, orders (decisions) in OHS matters, a decision on payment of remuneration, submissions and instructions, and — since 8 July 2026 — also a decision establishing the existence of an employment relationship (art. 11 and art. 33 of the PIP Act).
strings.Od decyzji wydanych na piśmie (art. 11 u: Against decisions issued in writing (art. 11(1)(1–7) and art. 11a) an appeal lies to the district labour inspector competent for the place of the inspection activities; the appeal is filed within 7 days of service of the decision (art. 34(5) of the PIP Act). In the case of an appeal against an OHS decision (art. 11(1)(2–4)), the district labour inspector may suspend enforcement of the decision until the appeal is examined, if the measures taken eliminate the immediate threat to life or health (art. 34(6)). Against a final administrative ruling a complaint lies to the voivodeship administrative court.
strings.Ścieżka odwoławcza jest inna dla „stosun: The appeal path is different for the “employment relationship”.
strings.Utrudnianie kontroli i naruszenia praw p: Obstructing an inspection and violating employee rights carry sanctions on two levels:
strings.<strong>Wykroczenie (Kodeks pracy).</str: Offence (Labour Code). Whoever obstructs the activity of a PIP authority — e.g. prevents an inspection of the establishment or fails to provide information necessary for the performance of its tasks — is liable to a fine (art. 283 § 2 of the Labour Code). Since 8 July 2026 the upper limits of fines for offences against employee rights have been raised; for some offences the range has risen to up to PLN 60,000, and in special cases of recidivism may reach as much as PLN 90,000.
strings.<strong>Przestępstwo (Kodeks karny).</st: Crime (Criminal Code). Whoever thwarts or obstructs the performance of an official act by a person authorised to inspect in the field of labour inspection (or a person called upon to assist them) is liable to imprisonment for up to 3 years (art. 225 § 2 of the Criminal Code).
strings.Do tego dochodzą odrębne sankcje za niel: On top of this come separate sanctions for illegal employment and illegal entrusting of work to a foreigner, provided for in the rules on employing foreigners.
strings.Największe ryzyko powstaje tam, gdzie ko: The greatest risk arises where the inspection is contentious (an employee complaint, an accident, an allegation of illegal employment) and where documentation is not in order. After the changes of 8 July 2026, two areas require particular attention: the B2B/civil-law contract cooperation model (risk of reclassification into an employment relationship) and the legality of employing foreigners (consistency of the residence card, permit/declaration and actual working conditions).
strings.Rekomendujemy: uporządkować akta osobowe: We recommend: putting personnel files and working-time records in order, verifying the residence titles and work bases of foreigners, preparing an internal inspection procedure and — in the event of a dispute — making use of the deadline for objections to the report (7 days) and the appeal (7 days from service of the decision). In contentious cases it is worth consulting a lawyer before these deadlines expire.
strings.Spodziewasz się kontroli albo chcesz jej: Are you expecting an inspection or do you want to avoid being caught “by surprise”?
strings.Sprawdzimy dokumentację pracowniczą i le: We will check your employee documentation and the legality of employing foreigners, prepare an inspection procedure and help you file objections to the report and an appeal on time — while protecting your workers’ residence status.
strings.<strong>Nota prawna:</strong> artykuł ma: Legal note: this article is informational and does not constitute legal advice. Legal status: August 2026. Every case is different — consult a lawyer before making a decision. Data controller: Dariusz Włodarczyk Kancelaria TRC.

strings.Urząd twierdzi, że wysłał wezwanie. List: The office claims it sent the summons. No letter arrived, and there is no envelope in the file either
strings.To jedna z najbardziej niesprawiedliwych: This is one of the most unfair situations in residence cases. You get a text message saying the office has issued a summons. You wait for the postman. Nothing arrives. Six months later you find out that the deadline has passed and the case has taken a bad turn — because the office records contain a note saying "sent". The key question is whether there is anything in the file that actually confirms the dispatch. If there is neither a return receipt nor a returned envelope, the situation looks completely different from what the official note suggests.
strings.<strong>Skąd ten temat.</strong> W sierp: Where this topic comes from. In August 2026, "Gazeta Wyborcza" described the case of a nurse from Turkey working in Warsaw. She filed her temporary residence application on 15 February 2024, two days before her visa expired. On 2 August 2024 she received a text message about a summons to remedy formal deficiencies. According to the newspaper's account, the letter never reached her, and the office file contains no envelope confirming the dispatch either. We describe the legal mechanism here; we do not assess that particular case — we know its course solely from the press report.

strings.1. Kiedy pismo z urzędu jest naprawdę do: 1. When a letter from the office is actually served
strings.Terminy procesowe w Twojej sprawie biegn: Procedural time limits in your case run from effective service of the letter, not from the day an official printed it out or clicked "send". That distinction decides everything.
strings.Jeśli ustanowiłeś pełnomocnika, pisma id: If you have appointed a representative, letters go to them (Article 40 § 2 of the Code of Administrative Procedure) and such service is effective against you — even if the representative passed nothing on to you. We write about this separately in our article on a summons that went to the employer.
strings.<strong>SMS to nie doręczenie.</strong>: A text message is not service. A message saying "a summons has been issued and will be sent by post" only informs you about a technical step inside the office. It does not start the time limit and does not replace the letter. But it is valuable evidence — it shows the date from which you knew the letter existed, and that you did not ignore it.
strings.2. Awizo i fikcja doręczenia — jak to dz: 2. Delivery notice and deemed service — how it works
strings.Gdy listonosz nie zastanie adresata, uru: When the postman does not find the addressee, substituted service under Article 44 of the Code of Administrative Procedure comes into play. The postal operator keeps the item for 14 days, leaving a notice of the possibility of collection and, after 7 days, a second notice. If the item is not collected, the letter is deemed served on the last day of that period — even though it never physically reached your hands. Hence the name: deemed service.
strings.Ta konstrukcja działa jednak tylko wtedy: This construction, however, works only if all of its conditions have been met: the item was sent to the correct address, the notices were actually left and documented, and the periods were observed. A failure in any of these elements means there is no presumption.
strings.Tu leży sedno. <strong>To organ wywodzi: This is the heart of the matter. It is the authority that derives a legal effect from service, so it is the authority that must prove it. It is not for you to prove that the letter did not arrive — the office has to show evidence in the file that it did arrive, or that deemed service operated correctly.
strings.W aktach powinno się znaleźć jedno z dwo: The file should contain one of two things:
strings.<strong>zwrotne potwierdzenie odbioru</s: a return receipt with the recipient's signature and the date, or
strings.<strong>zwrócona koperta</strong> z adno: a returned envelope bearing the postal operator's annotations about the two delivery notices and the dates of those actions.
strings.Jeżeli nie ma ani jednego, ani drugiego,: If there is neither one nor the other, and all there is is an internal system note saying "sent", that is not proof of service. In such a situation there is no way to assume that the time limit for remedying deficiencies ever started to run — and if it never started, it could not have expired.
strings.<strong>Dlatego koperta bywa ważniejsza: That is why the envelope is sometimes more important than the letter itself. A returned envelope with the annotations is often the only document that decides whether the case goes on or has been closed without examination.
strings.4. Dlaczego niedoręczone wezwanie potraf: 4. Why an unserved summons can freeze a case for years
strings.W sprawach pobytowych spotykają się trzy: In residence cases three separate time limits meet, and it is worth telling them apart:
strings.<strong>Braki formalne wniosku — art. 64: Formal deficiencies in the application — Article 64 § 2 of the Code of Administrative Procedure. A summons with a time limit of not less than 7 days, on pain of the application being left without examination.
strings.<strong>Dokumenty na poparcie wniosku —: Documents supporting the application — Article 106(2a) of the Act on Foreigners. An evidentiary summons where the time limit may not be shorter than 14 days, and the voivode is to assess the time actually needed to obtain the document.
strings.<strong>Termin na decyzję — art. 112a us: The time limit for a decision — Article 112a(2) of the Act on Foreigners. Sixty days start running only from the last of these events: appearing in person, remedying formal deficiencies and submitting the documents.
strings.Konsekwencja jest nieoczywista i dotkliw: The consequence is counter-intuitive and painful: if the summons does not reach you, the case can sit for years while, formally, the time limit for dealing with it has not even started. So the office is not in default within the meaning of the regulations, even though from your perspective nothing is happening.
strings.Do tego dochodzi bariera, o której mało: On top of that comes a barrier few people know about: Articles 100c and 100d of the Act of 12 March 2022 on assistance to Ukrainian citizens suspended the running of time limits and excluded complaints about inaction and excessive length in residence cases handled by voivodes — with regard to all foreigners, not only Ukrainian citizens. By its order of 2 April 2025 the Provincial Administrative Court in Gliwice referred questions on this matter to the Court of Justice of the EU for a preliminary ruling (case C-254/25), and the Ministry of the Interior and Administration announced that it is waiting for that ruling.
strings.5. Co zrobić krok po kroku: 5. What to do, step by step
strings.<strong>Zabezpiecz SMS-a i status sprawy: Secure the text message and the case status. Take a screenshot showing the date and print out the case status from the system. This is proof that you learned about the letter from the system, not from the post.
strings.<strong>Nie czekaj na listonosza — wystą: Do not wait for the postman — ask for a copy. After such a text message, write to the office asking it to send you a copy of the summons and to state the date and method of its dispatch. That step alone can later serve as proof of your diligence.
strings.<strong>Skorzystaj z prawa wglądu w akta: Use your right to inspect the file (Article 73 of the Code of Administrative Procedure). Check whether the file contains a return receipt or a returned envelope with annotations about the delivery notices. You may take notes and copies and request certified copies.
strings.<strong>Sprawdź adres, na który poszło p: Check the address the letter was sent to. A frequent cause: the application was filed from a temporary address (accommodation provided by the employer, a room rented for a few months) and, after moving out, nobody reported the change in writing. A letter sent to the old address may be treated as served.
strings.<strong>Zgłoś aktualny adres do doręczeń: Report your current address for service in writing. With every move, to the file of the specific case, quoting the case number. An e-mail to an official is not enough.
strings.<strong>Dobierz środek do sytuacji.</str: Match the remedy to the situation. You react differently when a case has been left without examination and differently when a refusal decision has been issued. Details in our article application left without examination — how to save the case.
strings.<strong>Uwaga na pułapkę terminów.</stro: Beware of the time-limit trap. Leaving an application without examination is not a decision and no appeal lies against it — review takes place by way of a complaint about inaction. A refusal decision, by contrast, may be appealed to the Head of the Office for Foreigners within 14 days, through the voivode. Confusing these two paths costs you the case.
strings.6. Skala problemu: co ustaliły NIK i RPO: 6. The scale of the problem: what NIK and the Ombudsman found
strings.To nie są incydenty. Najwyższa Izba Kont: These are not isolated incidents. The Supreme Audit Office (NIK), examining five voivodeship offices in 2021–2023, assessed the handling of foreigners' cases negatively: 60 per cent of cases were conducted in breach of the regulations, and the longest processing time revealed for a single application was 2,700 days. NIK also recorded demands for documents the office already held, a lack of instruction about rights and obligations, and the setting of the date of initiation of proceedings contrary to Article 61 § 3 of the Code of Administrative Procedure — only once deficiencies had been remedied, a practice the administrative courts regard as improper.
strings.Rzecznik Praw Obywatelskich prowadzi w t: The Commissioner for Human Rights is pursuing general submissions on this matter (ref. XI.541.31.2021) and points to delays that have persisted for years. The scale of the workload explains part of the problem: according to figures cited by the Ombudsman, in 2023 the Mazovian voivode received over 147,000 residence applications, about a quarter of all applications in the country, and in 2024 — about 106,000.
strings.Dla Ciebie płynie z tego jeden praktyczn: For you, one practical conclusion follows: since the system can be unreliable, document every step on your side. Screenshots, dates, proofs of posting and letters added to the file are what later allows you to show that it was not you who neglected the case.
strings.Kto musi udowodnić, że wezwanie do mnie: Who has to prove that the summons reached me?
strings.Organ prowadzący sprawę. To urząd wywodz: The authority handling the case. It is the office that derives a legal effect from service and it is the office that gathers the evidence: a return receipt or a returned envelope with annotations about the two delivery notices. If neither document is in the file, there is no basis for assuming that the letter was served.
strings.Czy SMS z urzędu zastępuje doręczenie pi: Does a text message from the office replace service of a letter?
strings.Nie. SMS o wystawieniu pisma jest wyłącz: No. A text message about a letter being issued is merely information about a technical step. Procedural time limits are counted from effective service of the letter under the Code of Administrative Procedure, not from the date of a message on your phone.
strings.Czy mogę zobaczyć akta swojej sprawy pob: Can I see the file of my residence case?
strings.Tak. Prawo wglądu w akta, sporządzania n: Yes. The right to inspect the file, take notes and copies, and request certified copies follows from Article 73 of the Code of Administrative Procedure and is available to a party at every stage of the proceedings.
strings.Co zrobić, gdy urząd uznał pismo za dorę: What should I do if the office treated a letter as served by delivery notice, but I was not there?
strings.Domniemanie z doręczenia zastępczego moż: The presumption arising from substituted service can be rebutted. You have to show that the item was not left at the correct address or that the notification duty was not fulfilled. Evidence of staying elsewhere, a tenancy agreement, confirmation of a change of address reported to the office or the postal operator's records all serve this purpose.
strings.Urząd twierdzi, że wysłał, a Ty nic nie: The office says it sent it, and you received nothing?
strings.Sprawdzimy akta Twojej sprawy i ustalimy: We will check the file of your case and determine whether it contains any proof of service at all. That decides whether the time limit was running — and whether the case can still be saved.

Legal status: August 2026. Every case is different — consult a lawyer before taking any decision. Data controller: Dariusz Włodarczyk Kancelaria TRC.
