You paid once and the office wants a second payment. Stamp duty after moving to another voivodeship
strings.Data publikacji: 7 sierpnia 2026 · Autor: Published: 7 August 2026 · Author: Dariusz Włodarczyk Kancelaria TRC · Reading time: approx. 5 min
strings.Składając wniosek o zezwolenie na pobyt: When filing an application for a temporary residence permit, a foreigner pays stamp duty for the grant of the permit — from PLN 85 to PLN 440, depending on the type of permit. It is paid not to the voivode but to the municipality: stamp duty is municipal income, and an application without proof of payment will be treated by the office as incomplete. This is routine, and normally nobody gives it another thought.
strings.Do czasu. Bo jeśli w trakcie postępowani: Until it isn't. Because if you change your place of residence during the proceedings and move to another voivodeship, the case goes to a different voivode — and with it comes a question that can take you by surprise: do you have to pay the fee all over again?
strings.Scenariusz wygląda zwykle tak. Cudzoziem: The scenario usually looks like this. A foreigner files an application and pays the fee. A few months later they change job or flat and move to another voivodeship. They report the new address, the case is transferred to the competent authority — and then a summons arrives from the new office: please pay the stamp duty. The very same duty they paid a few months earlier. This text explains where such a demand comes from, whether it is justified and how to respond to it without risking the whole residence case.
strings.<strong>W jednym zdaniu.</strong> Jeden: In one sentence. One application gives rise to one obligation to pay stamp duty, and transferring the case to the competent authority does not create a new application — but the law makes no provision for transferring the payment between municipalities, which is where a very real dispute comes from, one that has to be played out so as not to lose the residence case.
strings.<a href=\"#sek1\">Skąd bierze się żądani: Where the demand for a second payment comes from
strings.<a href=\"#sek2\">Dlaczego jedna sprawa: Why one case means one payment
strings.<a href=\"#sek3\">Sprawdź, w jakim trybi: Check the legal basis of the office's summons
strings.<a href=\"#sek4\">Co zrobić, żeby nie st: What to do so as not to lose the case
strings.1. Skąd bierze się żądanie drugiej opłat: 1. Where the demand for a second payment comes from
strings.Właściwość wojewody w sprawach pobytowyc: The voivode's jurisdiction in residence cases is mobile. As a rule, a temporary residence permit is granted by the voivode competent for the foreigner's place of residence (Article 104(1) of the Act on Foreigners; the provision allows for exceptions). Moving to another voivodeship therefore changes the authority handling the case, and an authority has a duty to observe its jurisdiction of its own motion (Article 19 of the Code of Administrative Procedure). Voivodeship offices have ready-made forms for this — an application to transfer the case to the competent authority.
strings.Problem pojawia się po stronie pieniędzy: The problem arises on the money side. Under Article 12(2)(1) of the Stamp Duty Act, the competent tax authority is the one in whose area the authority that issued the permit has its seat. After the transfer, the permit will be issued by a different voivode, so a different municipality becomes competent. Meanwhile the payment sits in the account of the original municipality, and the law does not expressly regulate transferring it between municipalities — stamp duty is the income of a specific municipality. From the perspective of the office taking over the case, the fee simply has not come in. It is worth knowing that the Head of the Office for Foreigners has taken a clear position on this: it is the municipality that is not competent which should of its own motion transfer the fee paid to the account of the competent municipality. In practice this varies — more on that below.
strings.<strong>To nie jest złośliwość urzędnika: This is not an official being spiteful. It is a gap in the statute whose cost the administration shifts onto the party. It is worth remembering this when drafting your letter — the dispute is about a provision, not about the person on the other side of the counter.
strings.2. Dlaczego jedna sprawa to jedna opłata: 2. Why one case means one payment
strings.Argumenty przeciwko drugiej opłacie są m: The arguments against a second payment are strong. In order of weight:
strings.<strong>Obowiązek powstał raz i został w: The obligation arose once and has been performed. Article 6(1)(3) of the Stamp Duty Act: the payment obligation arises at the moment the application for the permit is filed. On that date the first voivode and the corresponding municipality were competent. The payment was correct. There is no provision requiring a performed obligation to be repeated.
strings.<strong>W dniu zapłaty nie da się zastos: On the date of payment, Article 12(2)(1) cannot be applied. The provision refers to the authority that issued the permit — in the past tense. When filing an application, nobody knows who will ultimately issue the decision. An interpretation under which the party must predict future jurisdiction demands the impossible.
strings.<strong>Tak samo orzekł sąd administracy: An administrative court has ruled the same way. The Provincial Administrative Court in Łódź dealt with exactly these facts: an application filed and paid for in one voivodeship, transferred after a move to another, where the authority demanded payment again. The court held that the authority taking over the case had before it an application that had already been paid for: "There were therefore no grounds to summon the party to pay for the application once again" (judgment of 15 February 2023, ref. III SAB/Łd 150/22, final).
strings.<strong>Zasady ogólne postępowania.</str: General principles of procedure. Articles 8 and 9 of the Code of Administrative Procedure — the authority must conduct proceedings in a way that inspires confidence and has a duty to inform the party properly. Burdening a foreigner with the consequences of a gap in settlements between municipalities is hard to reconcile with these principles.
strings.<strong>Sprawa, która przeszła całą drog: A case that went the whole way. In the case ended by the judgment of the Provincial Administrative Court in Łódź (ref. III SAB/Łd 150/22), the application was filed and paid for in the amount of PLN 440 in the Greater Poland Voivodeship and, after a change of residence, transferred to the Łódź Voivodeship. There the authority summoned the applicant to pay again and, faced with a refusal, returned the application by order. The Head of the Office for Foreigners set that order aside, pointing out that the fee is paid once, at the moment the application is filed, and that settlements between tax authorities are outside the scope of the residence case. The municipality that had received the money refused to transfer it, claiming that a refund is made only at the party's request. The proceedings lasted more than 40 months in total; the court found excessive delay with a gross breach of the law and awarded the foreigner PLN 800 as a sum of money. This case shows one thing: the argument wins, but the dispute itself can cost years.
strings.3. Sprawdź, w jakim trybie urząd Cię wez: 3. Check the legal basis of the office's summons
strings.To najważniejszy szczegół w całym piśmie: This is the most important detail in the whole letter, and the one most often overlooked. The remedy available to you depends on the legal basis of the summons:
strings.<strong>Art. 261 § 1–3 k.p.a.</strong> —: Article 261 §§ 1–3 of the Code of Administrative Procedure — failure to pay a charge payable in advance. A time limit of 7 to 14 days and, if it passes without effect, return of the application by an order against which a complaint lies. A real and cheap remedy.
strings.<strong>Art. 64 § 2 k.p.a.</strong> — br: Article 64 § 2 of the Code of Administrative Procedure — a formal deficiency (no proof of payment in the file). A time limit of not less than 7 days, on pain of the application being left without examination. This is an act, not a decision — no complaint lies, review belongs to the administrative court.
strings.<strong>Najmocniejszy przepis w tej sytu: The strongest provision in this situation: Article 261 § 4(1) of the Code of Administrative Procedure. The authority should deal with the application despite non-payment if this is warranted by social considerations or by an important interest of the party. A case on which the legality of residence and the right to work depend is a textbook example of an important interest of the party. This provision allows you to demand that the office conduct the case alongside the fee dispute, rather than instead of it.
strings.4. Co zrobić, żeby nie stracić sprawy: 4. What to do so as not to lose the case
strings.Zasada nadrzędna brzmi: <strong>spór o k: The overriding rule is this: a dispute over a few hundred zloty is conducted alongside the residence case, never instead of it. What is at stake is the legality of your residence, not the amount of the fee.
strings.<strong>Uprzedź problem już przy przekaz: Head the problem off when the case is transferred. Attach to the application for transfer to the competent authority the proof of payment and one sentence: the fee was paid when the application was filed, in accordance with Article 6(1)(3) of the Stamp Duty Act. This is often enough for the issue never to arise.
strings.<strong>Jeśli wezwanie już przyszło — od: If the summons has already arrived — reply within the time limit, do not stay silent. Invoke Article 6(1)(3) of the Stamp Duty Act, Article 261 § 4(1) of the Code of Administrative Procedure and the judgment of the Provincial Administrative Court in Łódź, ref. III SAB/Łd 150/22. Attach confirmation of the transfer.
strings.<strong>Wariant bezpieczny: zapłać i odz: The safe option: pay and recover. Pay the disputed amount into the account indicated by the new office and at the same time file an application for a declaration of overpayment with the municipality that already has the money. The residence case does not stop, and the money comes back through a separate procedure.
strings.<strong>Nie wycofuj wniosku.</strong> Wy: Do not withdraw your application. Withdrawal ends in discontinuance of the proceedings and, for applications filed on or after 5 March 2026, stamp duty is not refundable in the event of discontinuance. You lose both the fee and the original date of filing, on which the legality of your residence depends. We discuss the rules on refunds separately in our article on the refund of stamp duty for a temporary residence application.
strings.<strong>Jeśli sprawa stoi — sięgnij po p: If the case is at a standstill — reach for a ponaglenie. A dispute over the fee does not excuse the authority's inaction. A ponaglenie (a formal urging of the authority) under Article 37 of the Code of Administrative Procedure, and then a complaint to the administrative court, are a real remedy here: in case III SAB/Łd 150/22 the court found excessive delay with a gross breach of the law and awarded the foreigner a sum of money.
strings.<strong>Co z odzyskaniem pieniędzy z pie: What about recovering the money from the first municipality. In our view, the March exclusions of refunds do not block this route: they concern refunds after a refusal decision and after discontinuance of proceedings, whereas here we are dealing with a fee paid into the account of an authority that ultimately turned out not to be competent — a different procedure and a different legal basis. It must be said honestly, however, that a municipality may take a different position. In case III SAB/Łd 150/22 the municipality refused to transfer the fee, stating that a refund is made only at the party's request. That is why the application to the municipality has to be filed by you and you should not count on the offices sorting it out between themselves.
strings.Czy po przekazaniu sprawy do innego woje: Do I have to pay stamp duty a second time after the case is transferred to another voivode?
strings.Naszym zdaniem nie. Obowiązek zapłaty po: In our view, no. The payment obligation arises when the application is filed (Article 6(1)(3) of the Stamp Duty Act) and it was performed at that point towards the authority then competent. Transferring the file is not a new application. In practice, however, some offices do demand payment into the account of the new voivode's municipality — which is why it is worth pre-empting this dispute in writing.
strings.Dlaczego urząd w ogóle tego żąda?: Why does the office demand this at all?
strings.Bo art. 12 ust. 2 pkt 1 ustawy o opłacie: Because Article 12(2)(1) of the Stamp Duty Act ties the jurisdiction of the tax authority to the seat of the authority that issued the permit. After the transfer, the permit will be issued by a different voivode, and the law makes no provision for transferring the payment between municipalities. From the new municipality's point of view, the fee has not come in.
strings.Co zrobić, żeby nie stracić sprawy pobyt: What should I do so as not to lose the residence case?
strings.Bezpieczny wariant to zapłacić kwotę spo: The safe option is to pay the disputed amount into the account indicated by the new office and, in parallel, apply for a declaration of overpayment to the municipality that already has the money. The residence case continues and the money comes back through a separate procedure.
strings.Czy lepiej wycofać wniosek i złożyć nowy: Is it better to withdraw the application and file a new one in the new voivodeship?
strings.Nie. Wycofanie prowadzi do umorzenia pos: No. Withdrawal leads to discontinuance of the proceedings and, for applications filed on or after 5 March 2026, stamp duty is not refundable in the event of discontinuance. A new application also means a new fee and the loss of the original filing date, on which the legality of your residence depends.
strings.Czy odzyskanie opłaty z pierwszej gminy: Do the new rules on no refunds block recovery of the fee from the first municipality?
strings.Naszym zdaniem nie. Nowe wyłączenia z us: In our view, no. The new exclusions in the Act on Foreigners concern refunds after a refusal decision and after discontinuance of proceedings. Here we are dealing with a different procedure — a fee paid into the account of an authority that ultimately is not competent. A municipality may, however, take a different position, and the application has to be filed by you; there is a known case of a refusal to transfer a fee between municipalities.
strings.<strong>Z naszej praktyki.</strong> Znam: From our practice. We know of cases in which the office taking over a case after a move summoned the foreigner to pay the stamp duty again, refusing to recognise the payment made into the account of the previous voivode's municipality. So this is not a theoretical problem — it is also confirmed by the judgment of the Provincial Administrative Court in Łódź cited above. If you have received such a summons, keep it together with the confirmation of the first payment — these two documents are the basis of all further argument.
strings.Urząd żąda opłaty drugi raz?: The office is demanding the fee a second time?
strings.Sprawdzimy podstawę prawną wezwania i pr: We will check the legal basis of the summons and prepare a reply that will not stop your residence case. And if the fee really did end up in the wrong place, we will also take care of recovering it.
strings.<strong>Nota prawna:</strong> artykuł ma: Legal notice: this article is informational and does not constitute legal advice. The legal assessment presented is supported by the final judgment of the Provincial Administrative Court in Łódź of 15 February 2023, ref. III SAB/Łd 150/22; this is not, however, a ruling of the Supreme Administrative Court, and we are not aware of any official communication resolving this question in general terms. We do not assess the conduct of any particular office or official; we describe a legal mechanism arising from a gap in the regulations. Legal status: August 2026. Every case is different — consult a lawyer before taking any decision. Data controller: Dariusz Włodarczyk Kancelaria TRC.

strings.Przeprowadzka do innego województwa, spr: You move to another voivodeship, the case goes to a new voivode — and the office demands stamp duty a second time. Find out whether you really have to pay again.

strings.Zwrot opłaty skarbowej za wniosek o poby: Refund of stamp duty for a temporary residence application — who is entitled to it and when in 2026
strings.Data publikacji: 4 sierpnia 2026 · Autor: Published: 4 August 2026 · Author: Dariusz Włodarczyk Kancelaria TRC · Reading time: approx. 8 min
strings.Wniosek o zezwolenie na pobyt czasowy ko: An application for a temporary residence permit costs money. The stamp duty for granting it is from PLN 85 to PLN 440 depending on the type of permit, an amendment to a temporary residence and work permit costs PLN 220, and a permanent residence permit and a long-term EU resident permit — PLN 640 each. For many people this is a substantial amount. The question that comes up most often in our office is: if I did not get the permit, will I get the money back?
strings.Do niedawna odpowiedź w większości przyp: Until recently the answer in most cases was "yes". Since 5 March 2026 it has been different — and it is precisely this change that surprises the most people. Below we explain how the new rules relate to the general principle of refunding stamp duty: what has changed and what has stayed the same.
strings.<strong>W jednym zdaniu.</strong> Ogólna: In one sentence. The general rule still holds: stamp duty comes back if, despite payment, no permit was issued. But for residence applications filed on or after 5 March 2026, the Act on Foreigners introduced an exception — a refusal decision and discontinuance of the proceedings no longer give rise to a right to a refund.

strings.1. Zasada ogólna: kiedy opłata skarbowa: 1. The general rule: when stamp duty is refundable
strings.Punktem wyjścia jest <strong>art. 9 usta: The starting point is Article 9 of the Act of 16 November 2006 on Stamp Duty. That provision identifies two situations in which the duty paid returns to the applicant's pocket:
strings.<strong>Nie dokonano czynności urzędowej: No official act was performed — even though the duty for it had been paid (Article 9(1)(1)).
strings.<strong>Nie wydano zaświadczenia lub zez: No certificate or permit was issued (authorisation, licence) — even though the duty for it had been paid (Article 9(1)(2)).
strings.Do sprawy pobytowej pasuje punkt drugi:: The second point fits a residence case: the duty is paid for the grant of a permit. If the permit is ultimately not granted, no consideration for the duty has arisen — so as a rule the duty comes back.
strings.Do tego dochodzą dwie reguły techniczne,: To this are added two technical rules you need to know:
strings.<strong>Zwrot następuje wyłącznie na wni: A refund is made only on application (Article 9(2)). No office will return the money of its own motion, automatically. Whoever does not file an application gets nothing.
Five years and that's it (Article 9(3)). The duty is not refundable after five years, counting from the end of the year in which the payment was made.
strings.2. Wyjątek od 5 marca 2026 r. — odmowa i: 2. The exception from 5 March 2026 — refusal and discontinuance
strings.5 marca 2026 r. weszły w życie zmiany w: On 5 March 2026 amendments to the Act on Foreigners came into force, introduced by the so-called phase-out act — the Act of 23 January 2026 on phasing out the arrangements arising from the Act on assistance to Ukrainian citizens in connection with the armed conflict on the territory of that state and amending certain other acts (Journal of Laws, item 203).
strings.Nowe przepisy — <strong>art. 77d, art. 8: The new provisions — Articles 77d, 87a, 113c, 120c, 207b and 223a of the Act on Foreigners — establish exceptions to the rule described above from Article 9(1)(2) of the Stamp Duty Act. Their effect is simple and severe: the stamp duty paid is no longer refundable at the foreigner's request where the case ends with:
strings.<strong>Uwaga na wycofanie wniosku.</str: Beware of withdrawing your application. Giving up the proceedings usually ends in a decision discontinuing them. Before 5 March 2026 this was, for many people, the natural route to recovering the fee — for example when their professional situation changed and the application no longer made sense. For applications filed on or after that date this route has been closed: discontinuance falls within the catalogue of exclusions.
strings.Wyjątki stosuje się <strong>bez względu: The exceptions apply regardless of the applicant's nationality or of whether they are stateless. Although the change was introduced by an act concerning assistance to Ukrainian citizens, its effect is universal.
strings.3. Jakich wniosków dotyczy nowa reguła: 3. Which applications the new rule covers
strings.Zgodnie z komunikatem Urzędu do Spraw Cu: According to the announcement of the Office for Foreigners, the exclusion of refunds covers stamp duty for:
strings.udzielenie zezwolenia na <strong>pobyt c: the grant of a temporary residence permit — rates from PLN 85 to PLN 440, depending on the type of permit,
strings.<strong>zmianę zezwolenia na pobyt czaso: amendment of a temporary residence and work permit — PLN 220,
strings.udzielenie zezwolenia na <strong>pobyt s: the grant of a permanent residence permit — PLN 640,
strings.udzielenie zezwolenia na pobyt <strong>r: the grant of a long-term EU resident residence permit — PLN 640,
strings.<strong>przedłużenie wizy</strong> Schen: extension of a Schengen visa (the equivalent of EUR 30) or a national visa (PLN 406),
strings.<strong>wydanie wizy Schengen na granicy: issue of a Schengen visa at the border by the commander of a Border Guard post (the equivalent of EUR 40 to 160).
strings.<strong>Decyduje data złożenia wniosku,: What counts is the date the application was filed, not the date of the decision. Under Article 29 of the phase-out act, the new provisions apply to duties paid in connection with applications filed on or after 5 March 2026. If your application came in earlier and the decision is only being issued now, the previous rules apply and a refund after a refusal or discontinuance is still possible. Check the filing date in your documents before you conclude that the money is lost.
strings.4. Kiedy zwrot nadal przysługuje: 4. When a refund is still available
strings.Nowy wyjątek nie skasował całej instytuc: The new exception has not wiped out the whole institution of refunds. It is narrow: it concerns two specific ways of ending a case. Beyond them, Article 9 of the Stamp Duty Act works just as before. In practice it is worth seeking a refund where:
strings.<strong>wniosek złożono przed 5 marca 20: the application was filed before 5 March 2026 — regardless of when the decision was issued;
strings.<strong>sprawa nie kończy się ani decyzj: the case ends neither with a refusal decision nor with discontinuance — the new provisions speak only of those two outcomes;
strings.zapłacono <strong>opłatę nienależną</str: an undue fee was paid, in an excessive amount or into the account of the wrong office — this, however, is the overpayment procedure, described in point 5.
strings.<strong>Nasza ocena, nie przesądzony sta: Our assessment, not settled law. Particular consideration is needed for leaving an application without examination. This is not a decision — it is a material and technical act, and review takes place before an administrative court, not by way of appeal. A literal reading of the new provisions, which speak of a "decision" refusing and a "decision" discontinuing, therefore supports the view that a refund is still available in such a case. This is, however, our interpretation and not an established practice of the tax authorities — the new provisions have been in force only since March 2026 and we are not aware of any case law confirming it. The position of the particular office in such a matter should be checked individually.
strings.5. Nadpłata to co innego niż zwrot: 5. An overpayment is something different from a refund
strings.Te dwa tryby bywają mylone, a prowadzą d: These two procedures are often confused, yet they lead to different conclusions and rest on different legal bases:
strings.<strong>Zwrot opłaty skarbowej.</strong>: Refund of stamp duty. The duty was due and correctly paid, but the office did not perform the act or did not issue the permit. Basis: Article 9 of the Stamp Duty Act. This is exactly where the new exception concerning residence cases applies.
strings.<strong>Stwierdzenie nadpłaty.</strong>: Declaration of overpayment. The duty was paid when it was not due, in an excessive amount or into the account of the wrong office. You file an application for a declaration of overpayment of stamp duty. The new provisions of the Act on Foreigners do not concern this procedure, because it is not about "consideration" for a permit that was not issued, but about money that was never due to the office in the first place.
strings.Jeżeli więc pomyliłeś rachunek albo wpła: So if you used the wrong account or paid more than the applicable rate, do not give up on recovering the money just because you have heard about the exclusion of refunds after a refusal. These are two different matters.
strings.6. Jak odzyskać opłatę krok po kroku: 6. How to recover the fee step by step
strings.<strong>Ustal datę złożenia wniosku poby: Establish the date your residence application was filed. It is this date that decides whether the old or the new rules apply. You will find confirmation in the MOS system or on your application receipt.
strings.<strong>Sprawdź, jak zakończyła się spra: Check how the case ended. A refusal decision and discontinuance are the situations covered by the exclusion. Leaving an application without examination is an act of a different kind — see point 4.
strings.<strong>Znajdź dowód zapłaty.</strong> P: Find the proof of payment. Confirmation of the transfer showing the recipient's account, the amount and the payment reference. Without it the office will summon you to remedy deficiencies.
strings.<strong>Ustal właściwy urząd.</strong> W: Identify the competent office. The application is addressed to the tax authority competent in stamp duty matters — that is, the head of the commune, the mayor or the city president (Article 12(1) of the Stamp Duty Act). In practice this is the office into whose account the money was paid — the statutory criterion is the seat of the authority that was to grant the permit, i.e. the municipality where the voivodeship office has its seat. The application is not addressed to the voivode. If you file it with the voivodeship office, it will be transferred to the competent authority.
strings.<strong>Złóż wniosek w terminie.</strong: File the application within the time limit. At the latest before five years have passed, counting from the end of the year in which you paid the duty. The application may be filed in person, by post or electronically.
strings.<strong>Jeśli działa pełnomocnik — dołąc: If a representative is acting — attach the power of attorney. Together with proof of payment of the stamp duty on the power of attorney, if it was due.
strings.Rozstrzygnięcie wniosku o zwrot należy d: The refund application is decided by the tax authority. If you disagree with its position, you may appeal to the local government board of appeal, through the office that issued the ruling — within 14 days of its service.
strings.<strong>Od 1 października 2026 r. tryb z: From 1 October 2026 the refund procedure changes. The Act of 29 May 2026 amending the Tax Ordinance and certain other acts (Journal of Laws of 2026, item 846), promulgated on 25 June 2026, amends the Stamp Duty Act with effect from 1 October 2026 — including the provisions on refunds. The course of proceedings described above reflects the law as at August 2026. If you file a refund application after 1 October 2026, check the current wording of Article 9 of the Stamp Duty Act or ask at the office about the applicable procedure — the amendment does not, however, change the exclusion of refunds in the event of a refusal decision or discontinuance described in this article, because that rule comes from the Act on Foreigners.
strings.7. Co to znaczy dla Ciebie w praktyce: 7. What this means for you in practice
strings.Zmiana z marca 2026 r. przesuwa ciężar r: The change of March 2026 shifts the burden of risk onto the applicant. Previously, filing an application "on the off chance" cost time and nerves, but the fee could be recovered. Today, if the case ends in a refusal, the fee stays in the budget — even where the refusal results from reasons the foreigner could not have foreseen.
strings.Praktyczny wniosek jest jeden: <strong>p: There is one practical conclusion: the conditions for the permit and the completeness of the documents are worth assessing before the application reaches the office, not after the first summons. This applies especially to borderline situations — loss of a job during the proceedings, a change of employer, doubts as to a stable source of income or insurance. These are what most often end in a refusal or discontinuance.
strings.Jeżeli już masz decyzję w ręku, sprawdź: If you already have a decision in hand, check two things in this order: the date the application was filed and the type of ruling. That determines whether there is anything to claim in your case at all.
strings.Czy po odmowie pobytu czasowego odzyskam: Will I recover the stamp duty after a refusal of temporary residence?
strings.Jeżeli wniosek złożono 5 marca 2026 r. l: If the application was filed on or after 5 March 2026 — no. The new provisions of the Act on Foreigners exclude a refund of stamp duty where a refusal decision or a decision discontinuing the proceedings is issued. For applications filed before that date the previous rules apply, that is a refund on application under Article 9(1)(2) of the Stamp Duty Act.
strings.Czy wycofanie wniosku pozwala odzyskać o: Does withdrawing the application allow me to recover the stamp duty?
strings.Przy wnioskach złożonych od 5 marca 2026: For applications filed on or after 5 March 2026, as a rule no. Withdrawing an application leads to discontinuance of the proceedings, and a decision discontinuing them is one of the situations in which the new provisions exclude a refund. Before that date, withdrawal was a typical route to recovering the fee.
strings.W jakim terminie trzeba złożyć wniosek o: Within what time limit must I file an application for a refund of stamp duty?
strings.Opłata skarbowa nie podlega zwrotowi po: Stamp duty is not refundable after five years, counting from the end of the year in which it was paid. This is a preclusive time limit — once it has passed, a refund is not possible whatever the reasons.
strings.Gdzie składa się wniosek o zwrot opłaty: Where do I file an application for a refund of stamp duty?
strings.Do organu podatkowego właściwego w spraw: To the tax authority competent in stamp duty matters, that is the commune or city office into whose account the money was paid. Not to the voivode who is handling the residence case. If the application reaches the voivodeship office, it is transferred to the competent authority.
strings.Czy opłata za wydanie karty pobytu też p: Is the fee for issuing a residence card also lost?
strings.Opłata za wydanie karty pobytu jest odrę: The fee for issuing a residence card is a separate fee, governed by the Act on Foreigners, and not stamp duty. The refund rule in Article 9 of the Stamp Duty Act and the exception described here do not cover it. The rules for settling it should be checked with the office handling the case.
strings.Zapłaciłem za dużo albo na niewłaściwe k: I paid too much or into the wrong account. What then?
strings.To nie jest sprawa zwrotu z art. 9, tylk: This is not a refund matter under Article 9, but an overpayment. You file an application for a declaration of overpayment of stamp duty. The new exception concerning refusal and discontinuance does not apply here, because an overpayment is a fee that was not due or was paid in an excessive amount.
strings.Nie wiesz, czy w Twojej sprawie opłata p: Not sure whether the fee in your case is lost?
strings.Sprawdzimy datę złożenia wniosku i rodza: We will check the date the application was filed and the type of ruling, and if a refund is due — we will prepare the application to the competent office. Before you file a new application, we will also assess the real chances of a positive decision.

strings.Zlecenie ze studentem lub uczniem do 26: A mandate contract with a student or pupil under 26: no ZUS contributions, work without a work permit, and the line beyond which penalties begin
strings.Data publikacji: 19 sierpnia 2026 · Auto: Publication date: 19 August 2026 · Author: Dariusz Włodarczyk Kancelaria TRC · Reading time: approx. 11 min
strings.Zakład Ubezpieczeń Społecznych rozszerzy: The Social Insurance Institution (ZUS) has expanded its inspections of companies that employ foreigners under mandate contracts and do not pay contributions, relying on the pupil or student status of a person under the age of 26. The exemption itself is lawful and there is no reason to give it up. The problem begins where the status is bought: a paid entry on the list of students of a post-secondary school, a certificate and a translation — without a single hour of study. Below we explain exactly how the contribution exemption works, which foreigners in education may work without a work permit, where the line of abuse lies, and how much crossing it actually costs.

strings.1. Zwolnienie ze składek — co dokładnie: 1. The contribution exemption — what the provision actually says
strings.Podstawą jest <strong>art. 6 ust. 4 usta: The basis is art. 6 ust. 4 of the Act of 13 October 1998 on the social insurance system (consolidated text: Dz.U. 2026 poz. 199). The provision reads: persons performing work under a mandate contract „are not subject to compulsory old-age and disability pension insurance if they are pupils of post-primary schools or students, until they reach the age of 26”.
strings.Trzy konsekwencje, które w praktyce decy: Three consequences that decide everything in practice:
strings.<strong>To nie jest ulga dla pracodawcy,: This is not a relief for the employer, but an exclusion on the side of the contractor. It applies by operation of law, requires no application and no consent from ZUS. Nobody „grants” it and nobody „awards” it.
strings.<strong>Odpada cały pakiet.</strong> Bra: The whole package falls away. The absence of compulsory old-age and disability pension insurance means no accident insurance, no possibility of joining sickness insurance and no health insurance on the basis of that mandate contract. The contract carries no contributions at all — on either side.
strings.<strong>Dotyczy wyłącznie umowy zlecenia: It applies solely to a mandate contract (and to other contracts for the provision of services to which the provisions on mandate contracts apply). A student on an employment contract is fully insured — regardless of age and status. A statutory exception is the activating contract for a nanny, to which the exemption does not apply (art. 6 ust. 4a u.s.u.s.).
strings.<strong>Obywatelstwo nie ma znaczenia.</: Citizenship is irrelevant. A foreigner is entitled to the exemption on the same terms as a Polish citizen. The country of the university is also irrelevant — the status of a student of a foreign university also falls within the provision, provided it is genuine and can be demonstrated.
strings.2. Dlaczego 26 lat i dlaczego właśnie uc: 2. Why 26 years of age and why specifically a pupil or student
strings.Konstrukcja opiera się na założeniu, że: The construction is based on the assumption that a person in education is not yet a full participant in the labour market: gainful work is for them an addition to education, not a source of subsistence and not a basis for building pension capital. Three decisions of the legislator follow from this.
strings.Kryterium jest status, nie sam wiek: The criterion is status, not age alone
strings.Zwolnienie nie należy się „każdemu młode: The exemption is not due to „every young person”. It is due to a person in education. A twenty-three-year-old without pupil or student status is subject to insurance on general terms. Age is only an upper limit, so that the privilege does not become open-ended.
strings.Odpowiada typowemu, wydłużonemu o studia: It corresponds to the typical point at which education ends, extended by second-cycle studies or a repeated year. The same limit appears later in tax law, which is the source of the most common misunderstanding in conversations with employers.
strings.<strong>Dwie różne „dwudziestki szóstki”: Two different „twenty-sixes”. The contribution exemption (art. 6 ust. 4 u.s.u.s.) requires age and pupil or student status. The tax „relief for the young” — art. 21 ust. 1 pkt 148 of the Personal Income Tax Act, with an annual income limit of 85 528 zł — requires only age and an appropriate source of income; it requires neither pupil nor student status. These are two independent institutions from two different acts.
strings.Tylko zlecenie, nigdy etat: Only a mandate contract, never employment
strings.To rozróżnienie jest celowe. Stosunek pr: This distinction is deliberate. An employment relationship presupposes permanence and subordination, so it does not fit the assumption of „additional work alongside study”. That is why a sham mandate contract performed under the conditions of employment collapses twice over: first as a mandate contract, second as a basis for the contribution exemption.
strings.3. Kto nie jest uczniem ani studentem w: 3. Who is not a pupil or a student within the meaning of the provision
strings.Zakres pojęcia jest węższy, niż zakładaj: The scope of the concept is narrower than employers assume. The exemption does not cover:
strings.<strong>doktorantów</strong> — uczestnik: doctoral candidates — a participant of a doctoral school is not a student within the meaning of this provision;
strings.<strong>słuchaczy studiów podyplomowych<: participants of postgraduate studies — also before reaching the age of 26;
strings.Status studenta trwa od immatrykulacji d: Student status lasts from matriculation until the day the diploma examination is taken or until the day of removal from the list of students. Removal takes effect as of the date of removal, and not until the end of the academic year — from that day the contribution obligation arises by operation of law, regardless of whether the principal found out about it. This single detail is the most frequent cause of arrears in companies that acted in good faith.
strings.<strong>Słuchacz szkoły policealnej</str: A student of a post-secondary school, on the other hand, falls within the category of a pupil of a post-primary school — and it is precisely this path that is today a field of abuse, because it is the shortest and cheapest to „obtain”.
strings.4. Legalizacja pracy: kto z uczących się: 4. Work legalisation: which people in education do not need a work permit
strings.Składki to jedno, legalność pracy — drug: Contributions are one thing, the legality of work is another. A foreigner who is exempt from contributions need not at all be exempt from the obligation to hold a work permit, and vice versa. The basis here is the Act of 20 March 2025 on the conditions for the admissibility of entrusting work to foreigners on the territory of the Republic of Poland (Dz.U. 2025 poz. 621, in force since 1 June 2025) and the Regulation of the Minister of Family, Labour and Social Policy of 20 November 2025 issued on its basis (Dz.U. 2025 poz. 1620, in force since 1 December 2025).
strings.Warunek wstępny: tytuł pobytowy uprawnia: Precondition: a residence title entitling the holder to work
strings.Zanim w ogóle bada się zwolnienia, trzeb: Before the exemptions are examined at all, it must be established whether the foreigner holds a residence title enabling them to take up work — the catalogue is set out in art. 3 ust. 3 of the Act (including selected visas, the voivode's stamp confirming submission of an application free of formal defects, a temporary residence permit, a residence document of another Schengen state, stay under visa-free travel). Without this step, any discussion of exemptions is pointless.
strings.Zwolnienia ustawowe istotne dla uczących: Statutory exemptions relevant to persons in education — art. 3 ust. 5 of the Act
strings.Pracę bez zezwolenia na pracę i bez oświ: Work without a work permit and without a declaration on entrusting work may be performed by a foreigner who:
strings.jest <strong>absolwentem szkoły ponadpod: is a graduate of a post-primary school referred to in art. 18 ust. 1 pkt 2 of the Education Law, and holds documents obtained in Poland confirming vocational qualifications (pkt 2);
strings.jest <strong>absolwentem studiów</strong: is a graduate of studies completed at a higher education institution having its seat in Poland (pkt 3) — both full-time and part-time;
strings.posiada <strong>stopień naukowy doktora<: holds the academic degree of doctor conferred in the Polish system of higher education and science (pkt 4);
strings.jest <strong>doktorantem w szkole doktor: is a doctoral candidate in a doctoral school run by an entity having its seat in Poland (pkt 5).
strings.<strong>Uwaga na absolwenta liceum.</str: Beware of the secondary school graduate. For graduates of post-primary schools, the Act requires two things jointly: completion of the school and Polish documents confirming vocational qualifications. Completion of a four-year general secondary school alone does not give the right to work without a permit.
strings.Zwolnienia z rozporządzenia — uczniowie: Exemptions from the regulation — pupils and students during their education
strings.Osoba, która jeszcze się uczy, korzysta: A person who is still studying benefits from the exemptions under Regulation Dz.U. 2025 poz. 1620. The most important ones for the subject of this article are:
strings.Kto może pracować bez zezwolenia na prac: Who may work without a work permit
strings.<strong>Student studiów stacjonarnych</s: A full-time student studying in Poland — at a unit approved by the minister competent for internal affairs for the purpose of admitting foreigners for the purpose of studies (art. 144 ust. 4 of the Act on Foreigners) or at a unit not subject to the approval requirement (art. 144 ust. 5) and in respect of which no decision prohibiting the admission of foreigners has been issued (art. 144a ust. 1)
strings.Student wykonujący pracę w ramach <stron: A student performing work as part of a professional placement provided for in the study programme at a higher education institution belonging to the Polish system of higher education and science
strings.Uczeń wykonujący pracę w ramach <strong>: A pupil performing work as part of a professional placement provided for in the curriculum at a post-primary school belonging to the Polish education system
strings.<strong>Młodociany</strong> zatrudniony: A juvenile employed under an employment contract for the purpose of vocational preparation
strings.<strong>Przepis epizodyczny wygasł 30 cz: The episodic provision expired on 30 June 2026. In the period from 1 December 2025 to 30 June 2026, § 1 pkt 12 was also applied to a full-time student at a non-public academic higher education institution or at a public vocational higher education institution that did not meet the condition set out in art. 144 ust. 4 of the Act on Foreigners. That period has now ended. From 1 July 2026, in the case of a full-time student one must therefore check the status of the higher education institution itself — otherwise the basis for exemption from the work permit may not exist, even though the student is in fact studying.
strings.Zwróćmy uwagę na asymetrię, która w prak: Note the asymmetry, which in practice surprises employers: a part-time (extramural) student during their studies does not fall within § 1 pkt 12 — the exemption concerns full-time studies. Meanwhile, after completing studies, the exemption under art. 3 ust. 5 pkt 3 of the Act covers graduates regardless of the mode of study. The same person may therefore need a work permit as a part-time student and cease to need one on the day of their diploma defence. On the ZUS side it is the opposite: during part-time studies the contribution exemption applies (up to the age of 26), and after the defence it expires immediately.
strings.5. Trzy niezależne tory: pobyt, praca, s: 5. Three independent tracks: residence, work, contributions
strings.To sedno całego zagadnienia i najczęstsz: This is the heart of the whole issue and the most frequent source of HR errors. The three legal regimes must be checked separately, because they have different conditions and different cut-off dates.
strings.Tytuł pobytowy: wiza, zezwolenie na poby: Residence title: visa, temporary residence permit, voivode's stamp, visa-free travel
strings.Data ważności dokumentu lub upływ okresu: The validity date of the document or the lapse of the period of stay
strings.Zezwolenie na pracę, oświadczenie o powi: Work permit, declaration on entrusting work or an exemption: art. 3 ust. 5 of the Act of 20.03.2025 or § 1 of Regulation Dz.U. 2025 poz. 1620
strings.Utrata statusu studenta stacjonarnego, z: Loss of full-time student status, change to a higher education institution not meeting the conditions, end of the placement
strings.Art. 6 ust. 4 u.s.u.s. — status ucznia l: Art. 6 ust. 4 u.s.u.s. — pupil or student status and age below 26, only under a mandate contract
strings.Dzień ukończenia 26 lat, dzień obrony, d: The day of reaching the age of 26, the day of the diploma defence, the day of removal from the list
strings.Praktyczny wniosek: obrona pracy dyplomo: Practical conclusion: the defence of a diploma thesis is good news for work legalisation, and for ZUS settlements it is the moment when the contribution obligation arises. The day of the 26th birthday changes nothing in work legalisation, but it ends the contribution exemption. HR must have both dates in the calendar.
strings.6. Na czym polega schemat, który kontrol: 6. What the scheme inspected by ZUS consists of
strings.Z doniesień o kontrolach wynika mechaniz: Reports on inspections reveal a repeatable mechanism: the employer engages a foreigner under the age of 26 under a mandate contract, and then arranges their entry on the list of students of a post-secondary school, financing document translations, entry fees and certificates. The contractor does not attend classes. The employer applies the exemption under art. 6 ust. 4 u.s.u.s., does not register them for insurance and does not pay contributions, and allocates part of the saved burden to a higher „take-home” rate, which makes the offer competitive against companies that settle honestly.
strings.Skala oszczędności wyjaśnia motywację. P: The scale of the savings explains the motivation. With full contributions on a mandate contract, the burden reaches the order of about 20 percent on the principal's side and about 22–23 percent on the contractor's side, depending on whether sickness insurance is joined, plus a 9 percent health contribution. For a team of several dozen people this amounts to sums counted in hundreds of thousands of zlotys per year.
strings.Dlaczego zaświadczenie nie chroni: Why a certificate does not protect you
strings.Zwolnienie jest oparte na <strong>fakcie: The exemption is based on a fact („is a pupil”), and not on a document („has a certificate”). A certificate of entry on the list of students is only evidence — and rebuttable evidence at that. The authority does not have to challenge the validity of the paper: it demonstrates the absence of genuine education (no attendance, no credits, no actual teaching activity in respect of that person) and questions the existence of the condition itself. This path is simpler than proving that the contract was a sham.
strings.<strong>Domniemanie rozszerzone na całą: A presumption extended to the whole company. After detecting irregularities among some of the persons employed, the authority is sometimes inclined to assume that the scheme covered all foreigners in the company, and to calculate the arrears collectively. Such an assumption is contestable — the insurance obligation is established individually in respect of each person, and an assessment decision must be individualised. In practice, however, the company first receives a decision for a high amount, and only fights to break up the collective assessment in an appeal to the social insurance court. The liquidity risk materialises before the dispute is resolved.
strings.7. Ile to kosztuje pracodawcę — kary i k: 7. How much it costs the employer — penalties and amounts
strings.Skutkiem podstawowym nie jest kara, lecz: The primary consequence is not a penalty, but the retroactive establishment of the insurance obligation and the assessment of contribution arrears. Contribution receivables become time-barred after 5 years from the day on which they became due (art. 24 u.s.u.s.), so an inspection reaches much further back than the current year — this is the main multiplier of the amount. The payer is also liable for the part of the contributions financed by the insured person, and recovering it from a former contractor who has left Poland is in practice illusory.
strings.Naliczane od dnia następującego po termi: Charged from the day following the payment deadline, at the rate of late payment interest on tax arrears applicable in a given period. Over a five-year horizon it constitutes a significant, not a marginal, component of the liability.
strings.Opłata dodatkowa do 100 procent zaległyc: An additional charge of up to 100 percent of the contribution arrears
strings.W razie nieopłacenia składek lub opłacen: In the event of failure to pay contributions or payment of an understated amount, ZUS may impose on the payer an additional charge of up to 100 percent of the unpaid contributions (art. 24 u.s.u.s.). It is financed exclusively from the payer's own funds and cannot be passed on to the insured person. A fictitious pupil status is precisely the type of factual situation — deliberate and organised action, not an arithmetical error — in which the authority reaches for the upper end of the range.
strings.<strong>Efekt łączny.</strong> Zaległość: The combined effect. Arrears plus interest plus an additional charge of up to 100 percent mean that the actual liability may exceed twice the amount saved on contributions.
strings.Grzywna do 46 000 zł: A fine of up to 46 000 zł
strings.Zgodnie z art. 98 ust. 1 u.s.u.s. płatni: Under art. 98 ust. 1 u.s.u.s., a contribution payer or a person obliged to act on their behalf who fails to fulfil the obligation to pay contributions on time, fails to report the required data or reports untrue data, gives untrue explanations or refuses to give them, frustrates or obstructs an inspection, fails to keep contribution records or fails to send declarations and reports on time — is subject to a fine of up to 46 000 zł. Liability is personal: it also applies to a member of the management board and to the person running HR, if they were obliged to act on behalf of the payer. Separate attention should be paid to obstructing an inspection — it is a self-standing offence, so waiting out ZUS summons adds a separate sanction to the main case.
strings.Odpowiedzialność karna z art. 219 Kodeks: Criminal liability under art. 219 of the Criminal Code
strings.Naruszenie przepisów o ubezpieczeniach s: Infringement of the provisions on social insurance by failing to report — even with the consent of the person concerned — the required data, or by reporting untrue data affecting the right to benefits or their amount, is punishable by a fine, restriction of liberty or imprisonment of up to 2 years. The foreigner's consent to the scheme does not exclude liability — the provision expressly provides for this. Where there is an organised circulation of certificates of non-existent education, depending on the findings in the given case, the provisions on certifying an untruth in a document and on using such a document also come into play, as well as liability on the part of the institution issuing the certificates.
strings.Ryzyko przekwalifikowania zlecenia na st: The risk of reclassifying a mandate contract as an employment relationship
strings.Jeżeli praca była wykonywana w warunkach: If the work was performed under conditions characteristic of employment, full employee contributions are added to the contribution arrears, and with them the minimum wage, overtime supplements and holiday equivalents. The case then ceases to concern ZUS alone.
strings.To wątek, o którym w opisach kontroli mó: This is the thread that is least discussed in accounts of inspections, and for our clients it is the most important. The person written into the scheme is not its beneficiary, but its second victim.
strings.<strong>Brak ubezpieczenia zdrowotnego</: No health insurance for the whole period — no real access to benefits financed from public funds, despite performing work.
strings.<strong>Brak historii składkowej</strong: No contribution history — and therefore no simplest proof of performing work in residence proceedings. In a case concerning a single permit for temporary residence and work, and in the case of a permanent residence permit, the authority examines whether the employment is genuine and what the source of income is; a gap in ZUS records is often a basis for doubt.
strings.<strong>Brak okresów ubezpieczenia</stro: No insurance periods relevant to future benefits, including entitlements acquired in Poland and subsequently settled in another country.
strings.<strong>Ryzyko po stronie legalizacji pr: Risk on the work legalisation side — if the basis for work was an exemption linked to full-time student status and that status turned out to be fictitious, it is not only the settlement of contributions that is called into question, but the very legality of the work performed.
strings.9. Jak korzystać ze zwolnień bezpiecznie: 9. How to use the exemptions safely
strings.Zwolnienie z art. 6 ust. 4 u.s.u.s. i zw: The exemption under art. 6 ust. 4 u.s.u.s. and the exemptions from the obligation to hold a work permit are lawful and there is no reason to give them up. Risk arises only where the status is bought or out of date. Minimum checks on the employer's side:
strings.<strong>Weryfikuj status u źródła, nie u: Verify the status at the source, not with the contractor. A certificate directly from the school or higher education institution; in the case of a foreign institution — a translation and a check of whether the institution actually provides education.
strings.<strong>Sprawdź status uczelni, nie tylk: Check the status of the higher education institution, not only of the student. From 1 July 2026, after the expiry of the episodic provision, in the case of a full-time student it must be established whether the unit conducting the studies is approved for the purpose of admitting foreigners or whether it is not subject to the approval requirement.
strings.<strong>Weryfikuj cyklicznie, nie jednor: Verify periodically, not once. At least once a semester, with a contractual obligation to report the loss of status immediately and a sanction for breaching it.
strings.<strong>Wpisz do systemu kadrowego dwie: Enter two dates into the HR system: the 26th birthday and the expected date of the diploma defence or completion of education. Both end the contribution exemption by operation of law.
strings.<strong>Nie finansuj wpisów, opłat szkol: Do not finance entries, school fees or translations for the contractor. The fact that the employer paid for them is for the authority the strongest evidence that the aim was not education, but avoidance of a public levy.
strings.<strong>Traktuj jako sygnał ostrzegawczy: Treat a school indicated by an intermediary as a warning sign. If the institution is „arranged” by an agency or by the employer itself rather than by the contractor, the scheme is in practice indefensible.
strings.<strong>Rozdziel trzy tory w dokumentacj: Separate the three tracks in your documentation. A separate note for residence, a separate one for the basis of work legalisation, a separate one for the basis of the contribution exemption — each with its expiry date.
strings.<strong>Sprawdź realność zlecenia.</stro: Check that the mandate contract is genuine. No fixed hours, no subordination and no attendance records typical of employment — otherwise the risk is twofold.
strings.Masz w firmie zleceniobiorców „na status: Do you have contractors „on student status” in your company?
strings.Sprawdzimy podstawy zwolnienia składkowe: We will check the grounds for the contribution exemption and for work legalisation for each person separately, indicate the periods of real risk and prepare documentation for an inspection — and in the event of a ZUS decision we will help prepare an appeal within the deadline, protecting the residence status of your employees.

strings.<strong>Wniosek możesz złożyć sam — ale:
You can file the application yourself — but you do not have to do it alone The MOS system is free and you can complete it without anyone's help. A lawyer will not issue the decision instead of the authority, and no honest person will promise you its content. What a representative does give you are three things you cannot secure on your own: an application filed without formal defects, control of deadlines and service of documents — the authority is obliged to serve letters on the representative — and a reaction when the authority exceeds deadlines or stays silent. A foreigner who does not know Polish procedure is the weakest party in these proceedings, and the representative's role is to make sure their rights are respected.

Check who you entrust your case to. A representative operating in Poland is answerable for their work under Polish law and you can establish who they are, where they are based and under what number they are registered. Be cautious about people who present themselves as experts in Polish regulations but cannot give those details.
strings.Jeżeli nie wiesz, którą kartę wybrać, od: If you do not know which card to choose, answer them one by one.
strings.<b>Po co jesteś w Polsce?</b> Pracujesz: Why are you in Poland? You work — go to the „Residence and work” section. You study — „Studies, family, other reasons”. You have family here — the same section.
strings.<b>Jak długo mieszkasz w Polsce?</b> Mni: How long have you lived in Poland? Less than 5 years — you file an application for temporary residence. More than 5 years legally — check permanent residence or EU long-term resident.
strings.<b>Czy masz już pracodawcę w Polsce?</b>: Do you already have an employer in Poland? If so and you want to settle residence and work with one decision — your application is the temporary residence and work permit. It is the most frequent choice.
strings.<strong>Przez internet czy na papierze?<: Online or on paper? Since 27 April 2026 applications for a temporary residence permit, a permanent residence permit and an EU long-term resident permit are filed exclusively online in the MOS portal. Four types of cases are still filed on paper — below they carry the yellow label Paper only. The application for the issue or replacement of the residence card itself is also filed on paper.
strings.Wybierz, jeśli pracujesz w Polsce lub ma: Choose this if you work in Poland or have a signed contract with an employer.
strings.Dla Ciebie, jeśli: <b>pracujesz u polski: For you if: you work for a Polish employer under an employment contract or umowa zlecenia and want to settle residence and the right to work with one decision. The so-called single permit.

strings.Dla Ciebie, jeśli masz <b>wyższe wykszta: For you if you have higher education or long professional experience and a high salary. The so-called EU Blue Card.
strings.Dla Ciebie, jeśli pracujesz <b>przez czę: For you if you work for part of the year — in agriculture, horticulture, hotels or catering.
strings.Dla Ciebie, jeśli <b>zagraniczna firma p: For you if a foreign company transfers you to its branch in Poland — as a manager, specialist or trainee. This application and long-term ICT mobility are filed on paper with the voivode (wojewoda).
strings.Dla Ciebie, jeśli <b>prowadzisz w Polsce: For you if you run your own company in Poland or hold a position on the management board of a company and are not employed.
strings.Wybierz, jeśli Twój pobyt w Polsce nie w: Choose this if your stay in Poland does not result from work. Note: if the person the application concerns is outside Poland, the family reunification application is filed on paper.

strings.Dla Ciebie, jeśli chcesz <b>sprowadzić d: For you if you want to bring to Poland your spouse or children and the person the application concerns is still abroad. If the family is already in Poland — the application goes through MOS.
strings.Dla Ciebie, jeśli Twój mąż albo żona <b>: For you if your husband or wife has Polish citizenship and you are in Poland. If you are outside Poland — the application is filed on paper.
strings.Dla Ciebie, jeśli <b>musisz stawić się o: For you if you have to appear in person before a Polish authority or court, or an exceptional personal situation keeps you in Poland.

strings.Dla Ciebie, jeśli masz <b>Kartę Polaka</: For you if you have the Pole's Card, Polish origin, have been married to a Polish citizen for at least 3 years or have refugee status. Residence card for 10 years.

strings.<strong>Do każdej opłaty dochodzi 100 zł: Each fee is topped up by 100 zł for the residence card itself These are two separate transfers: the stamp duty for the permit and 100 zł for issuing the residence card (50 zł for a child under 16, a pupil and a student). The amounts are the same throughout Poland — only the account numbers differ, and you take them from the website of the authority handling your case.

strings.Wybierz ten wniosek, jeżeli <b>pracujesz: Choose this application if you work for a Polish employer — under an employment contract or umowa zlecenia — and want to settle two things with one decision: the right to live in Poland and the right to work.
strings.Urząd nazywa to <b>zezwoleniem jednolity: The authority calls it a single permit. You then do not need a separate work permit.
strings.<strong>To Twój wniosek, jeżeli:</strong: This is your application if: you have a specific employer in Poland · you work or are about to start · you have somewhere to live and health insurance.
strings.<strong>To NIE jest Twój wniosek, jeżeli: This is NOT your application if: you run your own company · you study · you are coming to join family · you work seasonally a few months a year. Check the other types of application →
strings.<strong>Kiedy najpóźniej złożyć wniosek<: The latest moment to file At the latest on the last day of your legal stay. If you file it on time and it has no formal defects, your stay is legal until the day the decision becomes final — even if the case takes long. But do not wait until the last day: the employer's annex takes time.
strings.Nie otwieraj MOS, dopóki nie masz tych r: Do not open MOS until you have these things. Otherwise you will get stuck halfway.

Without it you will not log in to MOS. Instead of the trusted profile you may use a qualified electronic signature or a personal signature.</small>

strings.Zaloguj się dokładnie tak, jak logujesz: Log in exactly as you log in to your bank

strings.<strong>Nikomu nie podawaj swoich danych: Never give anyone your login details.A representative cannot log in to your account. They can, however, help you fill in the application while you are the one logged in.
strings.Poproś pracodawcę o załącznik — zrób to: Ask your employer for the annex — do it now, not at the end
strings.Uprzedź pracodawcę, że dostanie e-mail z: Warn your employer that they will receive an e-mail from the MOS system with a link
strings.Pracodawca wypełnia w tym linku informac: In that link the employer fills in the information about your work
strings.Pracodawca <b>podpisuje załącznik elektr: The employer signs the annex electronically — with a trusted profile or a qualified signature
strings.Gdy podpisze, dostaniesz e-mail „Wniosek: Once they sign, you will receive an e-mail „Wniosek jest już możliwy do złożenia” (The application can now be filed)
strings.<strong>Bez podpisanego załącznika syste: Without the signed annex the system will NOT let you send the application.The link for the employer is valid for 30 days. This is the most frequent reason why people do not make it before their legal stay ends.
strings.Po zalogowaniu kliknij <span class=\"btn: After logging in, click Złóż wniosek online (File an application online)
strings.Wybierz z listy: <b>zezwolenie na pobyt: Choose from the list: zezwolenie na pobyt czasowy (temporary residence permit)
strings.Jako cel pobytu wybierz: <b>wykonywanie: As the purpose of stay choose: wykonywanie pracy (performing work — temporary residence and work)
strings.Imię, nazwisko, datę urodzenia i numer p: Copy your first name, surname, date of birth and passport number letter by letter exactly as in the passport
strings.W polu adresu podaj miejsce, gdzie <b>fa: In the address field give the place where you actually live and receive letters
strings.W danych pracodawcy wpisz jego <b>adres: In the employer's details enter their e-mail address — this triggers sending the link from step 2
strings.<strong>Możesz przerwać w każdej chwili<: You can stop at any momentSave the draft and come back later. The draft waits for you 45 days from the last change. Fill it in calmly, bit by bit.

strings.Gdy pracownik urzędu zatwierdzi wniosek,: Once an official approves the application, download the certificate of filing the application — it replaces the former passport stamp
strings.<strong>Po kliknięciu „Wyślij” nie popra: After clicking „Wyślij” you can no longer correct anything.A sent application cannot be withdrawn or edited. A typo in the passport number means a summons to correct it and several weeks lost.
strings.Wizyta w urzędzie i decyzja: Visit to the authority and the decision
strings.Poczekaj na <b>wezwanie do osobistego st: Wait for the summons to appear in person from the voivode handling your case
strings.W urzędzie zostawisz <b>odciski palców</: At the office you will leave your fingerprints and specimen signature and show the original passport
strings.Decyzję urząd wyśle na wskazany adres do: The authority will send the decision to the indicated address for service — yours or your representative's
strings.Po decyzji pozytywnej odbierasz <b>kartę: After a positive decision you collect the residence card
strings.<strong>MOS nie przypomni Ci o niczym</s: MOS will not remind you of anythingThe portal does not inform you about the state of the case or the need to complete documents — an official of the voivodeship office does. If the authority calls on you to remedy defects, you will have at least 7 days for it. An unremedied defect means the application is left unexamined — and then the legality of your stay ends as well.
strings.<strong>Zmieniasz pracodawcę albo adres: Changing employer or address during the case?You notify the voivode outside the MOS portal — by a paper letter or to the office's e-Delivery address.
strings.Opłata skarbowa za zezwolenie na pobyt c: Stamp duty for the temporary residence and work permit
strings.Wydanie karty pobytu — dziecko do 16 lat: Issue of the residence card — child under 16, pupil, student
strings.Pełnomocnictwo, jeśli kogoś ustanawiasz: Power of attorney, if you appoint someone
Change of the residence and work permit (e.g. change of employer)
strings.<strong>Gdzie zapłacić</strong>Kwoty są: Where to payThe amounts are the same throughout Poland. Only the account numbers differ — you take them from the website of the voivodeship office that handles your case. You pay the stamp duty and the residence card fee separately. You cannot pay them in the MOS portal.
strings.Czy muszę iść do urzędu, żeby złożyć wni: Do I have to go to the office to file the application?
strings.Nie. Cały wniosek składasz przez interne: No. You file the whole application online. You do not book an appointment and do not queue. You will go to the office only when summoned — for fingerprints, the specimen signature and to show the original passport.
strings.Mogę przerwać wypełnianie i dokończyć ju: Can I stop filling it in and finish tomorrow?
strings.Tak. Zapisz wersję roboczą — możesz do n: Yes. Save the draft — you can come back to it for 45 days from the last changes.
strings.Czy ktoś może złożyć wniosek za mnie?: Can someone file the application for me?
strings.Nie. Logujesz się i podpisujesz osobiści: No. You log in and sign in person. The portal's rules forbid using someone else's account. A representative may help you fill in the application while you are logged in and run the case afterwards — including receiving letters from the authority on your behalf.
strings.Co, jeśli zmienię pracodawcę w trakcie s: What if I change employer during the case?
strings.Musisz powiadomić wojewodę — pismem papi: You have to notify the voivode — by a paper letter or electronically to the e-Delivery address, because the MOS portal does not support it. The single permit is tied to a specific employer and specific working conditions.
strings.Co, jeśli portal MOS nie działa w ostatn: What if the MOS portal is down on the last day of my legal stay?
strings.Wniosek złóż najpóźniej w ciągu 3 dni ro: File the application at the latest within 3 working days after the day on which the system's unavailability was removed. The first day of unavailability is taken as the date of filing.
strings.Czy dostanę stempel w paszporcie?: Will I get a stamp in my passport?
strings.Nie. Po zatwierdzeniu wniosku przez prac: No. After an official approves the application you download from MOS the certificate of filing the application. It replaces the former stamp, and the services checking the legality of stay see your application in the system.
strings.Na jak długo dostanę zezwolenie?: For how long will I get the permit?
strings.Maksymalnie na 3 lata. Urząd może dać kr: For a maximum of 3 years. The authority may grant a shorter period — usually as long as your employment contract lasts.
strings.6. Kiedy lepiej nie robić tego samemu: 6. When it is better not to do it alone
strings.Wniosek wypełnisz sam — system jest bezp: You can fill in the application yourself — the system is free and designed so that anyone can manage it. But in these situations one mistake costs several months and the legality of your stay:
strings.Miałeś już odmowę albo wniosek pozostawi: You have already had a refusal or an application left unexamined
strings.Twój legalny pobyt kończy się za mniej n: Your legal stay ends in less than two weeks
strings.Zmieniasz pracodawcę w trakcie postępowa: You are changing employer during the proceedings
strings.Pracodawca zwleka z podpisaniem załączni: The employer is slow to sign the annex
strings.Nie masz pewnego adresu, pod którym odbi: You have no reliable address at which you will receive the letter from the authority
strings.Urząd milczy od wielu miesięcy: The authority has been silent for many months
strings.<strong>Dlaczego warto mieć pełnomocnika: Why it is worth having a representative even if you file the application yourself The authority is obliged to serve letters on the representative. Your lawyer learns about the summons the same day — and you do not lose the case because you happened not to be at home when the postman came. No honest person will promise you the content of the decision, because it is the authority that issues it. What the representative is responsible for is that the application is complete, the deadlines are met and your rights in the proceedings are respected. Choose a person operating in Poland whom you can identify — name, seat, registration number.
strings.Nie chcesz pilnować tego sam?: Do not want to keep an eye on it alone?
strings.Sprawdzimy Twoją sytuację i powiemy wpro: We will check your situation and tell you plainly whether the application can be filed safely.

strings.Czy możecie przejąć sprawę, którą zaczął: Can you take over a case that another representative or agency has already started?
strings.Tak. Przejmujemy prowadzenie sprawy od d: Yes. We take over the case from the previous representative at any stage of the proceedings — from where the case currently stands through to the decision. You do not have to start over.
strings.Czy najpierw sprawdzicie, co już złożono: Will you first review what has already been filed and what is missing?
strings.Tak. Zaczynamy od analizy stanu sprawy i: Yes. We start by reviewing the status of the case and the documents held by the office (urząd): we identify formal deficiencies, assess the chances of a positive decision and issue a written legal opinion with recommendations. This is the scope of the REVIEW package (615 PLN, one-off), with a phone consultation of up to 30 minutes.
strings.Czy możecie zmienić pełnomocnika, który: Can you change the representative currently listed in the case?
strings.Tak. Zgłoszenie zmiany pełnomocnika w ur: Yes. Registering the change of representative with the office is included in the STANDARD and ALL INCLUSIVE packages. Once registered, we receive the correspondence and run the case.
strings.Czy odpowiadacie na wszystkie wezwania u: Do you respond to all requests from the Voivodeship Office (Urząd Wojewódzki) and file the necessary documents?
strings.Tak — w pakietach STANDARD i ALL INCLUSI: Yes — in the STANDARD and ALL INCLUSIVE packages. We supplement formal deficiencies, prepare submissions and respond to official requests within the set deadlines, and we represent you in the proceedings as your authorised representative (pełnomocnik).
strings.Czy prowadzicie sprawę aż do decyzji?: Do you follow the case through to the final decision?
strings.Tak. W pakietach STANDARD i ALL INCLUSIV: Yes. In the STANDARD and ALL INCLUSIVE packages we run the case to the decision and monitor its status at the office throughout the proceedings.
strings.A jeśli pojawi się problem, opóźnienie a: And if there is a problem, a delay or a negative decision — will you file the appeal?
strings.Tak. Prowadzenie sprawy do decyzji obejm: Yes. Running the case to the decision also covers the appeal (STANDARD and ALL INCLUSIVE). Where the proceedings are unduly delayed, separate remedies apply — a reminder (ponaglenie) followed by a complaint about administrative inactivity — which we also prepare.
strings.Ile kosztuje przejęcie mojej sprawy?: How much does taking over my case cost?
strings.Dla spraw już rozpoczętych obowiązują tr: For cases already under way, three “Case continuation” packages apply: REVIEW — 615 PLN one-off (review of the case status and documents, identification of deficiencies, a written legal opinion, a consultation of up to 30 min); STANDARD — 1650 PLN in 2 instalments (everything in Review plus change of representative, supplementing deficiencies, responses to official requests, representation and running the case to the decision including the appeal); ALL INCLUSIVE — 2200 PLN in 3 instalments (everything in Standard plus consultations on changing employer and on permanent residence/citizenship, handling of selected benefit applications and 12 months of support after the decision). We select the exact package after a free review of the file. In the packages with representation a fee-refund rule applies in the event of a negative decision — on the terms set out in the Terms of Service (Regulamin).
strings.Czy poza wynagrodzeniem są dodatkowe kos: Are there any additional costs besides your fee? Which documents should I send for the free review?
strings.Ceny pakietów nie obejmują opłat urzędow: The package prices do not include official fees (administrative fee — opłata skarbowa — of 440 / 100 / 17 PLN depending on the action) or third-party costs such as sworn translations, notarial fees or consular fees. For the free review, please send: proof of filing and the case reference number, all correspondence received from the office so far (requests, letters), your passport, your previous residence card or decision (if any) and any documents from your employer that you have. We will get back to you within 24 hours, in your language.
strings.Rozumiem 2200 zł za pakiet All Inclusive: I understand the 2200 PLN for the All Inclusive package. Where do the 440 PLN come from — is it a penalty for non-payment?
strings.Nie, to nie żadna kara. 440 zł to opłata: No, it is not a penalty. The 440 PLN is the administrative fee (opłata skarbowa) — a mandatory state fee for granting the temporary residence and work permit, paid to the office’s account, not to us. Every applicant pays it and it is separate from our fee. Other actions have lower fees: 100 PLN for issuing the residence card itself and 17 PLN for the power of attorney. These are the only mandatory official fees — our package fee is separate.
strings.Nie wiem, jakie dokumenty złożył poprzed: I don’t know what documents the previous representative submitted or what is missing — is that a problem?
strings.Nie. Właśnie po to jest pierwsza analiza: No. That is exactly what the first review is for. Just send us the case reference number — we will check the status of the file, establish what has already been submitted and what is missing, and prepare the list of deficiencies. You don’t need to know this in advance; we determine it for you.
